70010000133425.description:
Ducks In Disguise is a peaceful hidden-object game focused on discovering beauty within the chaos. Explore hand-drawn 2D scenes, each with its own atmosphere, and find the ducks hiding around every corner!

Hundreds of ducks have decided to play the biggest game of hide-and-seek ever! Your task is simple: carefully examine each scene, find the hidden ducks and complete your collection. But not every duck is easy to spot. Some have disguised themselves to blend into their surroundings, so you’ll need to pay close attention to the details to find them.

As you explore each scene, click on objects and interact with your surroundings. Sometimes a duck is hiding right in front of you, while other times you’ll need to interact with the environment to reveal it. Every duck you find brings you one step closer to completing your collection.

A Stress-Free Experience

In Ducks In Disguise, there are no time limits, high-score pressures or tasks that require you to rush. Play at your own pace, listen to relaxing lo-fi music, examine each scene and enjoy the satisfaction of finding all the ducks.

Hand-Drawn 2D Worlds

Explore carefully crafted, hand-drawn illustrations, each with its own atmosphere and visual details. Take a close look at the detailed scenes and discover new ducks as you spot the little details hidden throughout the environment.

Ducks in Disguise

Not every duck hides in the same way. Some special ducks disguise themselves by blending into their surroundings. Keep your eyes peeled and don’t miss even the smallest detail!

Find Them All

Complete your collection by finishing every scene and prove that you’re a true duck-finding expert. Find every hidden duck to unlock a special reward: the Quack Certificate!

Whether you’ve got five minutes to spare or want to play for hours, Ducks In Disguise is designed to help you relax, sharpen your observation skills and discover something new in every scene.

Can you find every hidden duck? Quack! Quack!
70010000133425.intro: Discover hidden ducks, find the ones in disguise, and enjoy a peaceful hidden-object adventure across beautifully hand-drawn worlds!
70010000133425.name: Ducks In Disguise

70010000120256.description:
APIDYA - A very special retro shoot 'em up buzzes into view!
Take flight in Apidya' Special, brought back through sheer Pixel Passion!

1992's home computer legend Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.

Developed by the original team, together with a devoted Apidya super-fan-turned-developer, Apidya' Special is based on a previously abandoned 1990s console port, combining original assets with all-new pixel art, additional authentic sound effects, and remixed music. Legendary composer Chris Hülsbeck contributes exclusive new studio versions of the iconic soundtrack that has never been released before.

The warmth and charm of a CRT on modern screens!

Players can experience Apidya' Special in true widescreen with new parallax effects or switch to the original home computer 4:3 mode that looks, plays, and sounds exactly like 1992. Optional CRT effects with simulated shadow mask, scan lines, and phosphor bloom recreate the classic display feel.

Features:
• Authentic Remake – Completely rebuilt from scratch; no emulation.
• Two Visual Modes – Seamlessly switch between HD widescreen or original 4:3 presentation.
• Exclusive Chris Hülsbeck OST – New studio versions of the iconic soundtrack, never before released.
• Retro Visual Effects – Optional CRT shaders, bloom, and authentic scanline simulation.
• Expanded Worlds – 5 diverse themed worlds (Meadow, Pond, Sewers, Cyber, Lair), up to 5 levels each, 20 unique bosses, and hidden special stages.
• Fresh Surprises – Randomized in-game events like "Night Mode" with new enemy sprites.
• Co-op Mode – Team up in the all-new co-op mode, where player two controls a fully featured bee with its own weapons.
• Accessibility Options – Modernized difficulty settings to make the game enjoyable for all generations.
70010000120256.intro: Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.
70010000120256.name: Apidya‘ Special

70010000104178.description:
A Tower Full of Cats is a cozy and charming hidden object game where your mission is simple: find every cat across the entire history of catkind… and beyond!
Climb through time in this vertical, whimsical adventure packed with secrets, surprises, and—of course—cats.

Travel across beautifully illustrated levels representing different eras and worlds, each overflowing with adorable felines hiding in plain sight. Discover over 1,400 cats, uncover special items, and reveal delightful surprises as you ascend the mysterious Tower of Time.

Whether you're a completionist, a cat lover, or simply looking for a relaxing and rewarding experience, A Tower Full of Cats delivers a playful journey that keeps you smiling at every floor.

Features

- 1,400+ Cats to Find: A massive collection of unique and quirky felines hiding everywhere.
- Time-Traveling Levels: Explore different eras and fantasy settings as you climb the Tower.
- Extra Secrets: Hidden objects, bonus collectibles, special cats, and surprises in every scene.
- Adaptive Soundtrack: Music that evolves with each stage, creating a cozy and immersive ambiance.
- Relaxing Gameplay: No timers, no stress—just pure hidden-object fun focused on exploration.
- All Ages Friendly: Perfect for kids, adults, and anyone who loves cats (or discovering things!).
70010000104178.name: A Tower Full of Cats

70010000117524.description:
Fractured Worlds is a Dark Fantasy Action RPG set in a reality that has been broken into pieces by the ambition of its inhabitants. Now, guided by a mysterious voice, you must explore these broken realms, piece together the past, and confront those responsible for this cataclysmic event.

Deliberate, Precision-Based Combat
Each weapon has its own weight, speed and moveset. From two handed maces with slow staggering attacks, to nimble spears perfect for crowd controlling enemies and magic wands controlling the flow of Aether - everything plays and feels different. The classless progression system allows for multiple respecs so it’s easy to try a little bit of everything or adjust your character to a particularly powerful Legendary item you find.

Encounter Other Players
Reality's distortion means that the worlds of other players might briefly overlap with yours. You can choose to interact with them, or simply continue on your own path. You can invade and assist, support and deceive, share a profitable loot pile or lure other players into a particularly deadly mob of enemies and collect the spoils once they are dealt with.

Explore Diverse, Broken Realms 
Journey through unique procedural environments that are fragments of former worlds. Navigate medieval Dungeons, the mystical enchanted Forests, volcanic landscapes, and future industrial Cities. Find memory fragments that reveal the stories of those affected by the cataclysm, helping you understand what happened and mend the broken world.

Share a Piece of Your World
Map Shards are powerful artifacts that allow players to share a piece of their world with others. Map Shards create a co-operative instance with random modifiers that unpredictably alters the monsters that inhabit the area and boost the loot they are guarding. When sharing the area with others, players can comment on it letting everyone know about what to expect in the area: vast riches or especially challenging encounters.

Face Challenging Bosses 
Confront powerful bosses that stand in your way. Battle the Treasure Golem, the mind-altering Rorsch, the imposing Ghostly Knight, and many more. Each boss encounter is a tough and deadly challenge where a single mistake can cost you a significant chunk of your health if played poorly. But every action in these fights is thoughtfully designed and well-telegraphed, so with practice, you can conquer even the greatest foe.

Fractured Worlds offers a journey through a broken reality, focusing on direct action and the task of restoring what was lost.
70010000117524.name: Fractured Worlds

70010000070279.description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.

The game takes place five years after the Big Shell incident in METAL GEAR SOLID 2: Sons of Liberty, in a world where war has become a business.
To stop Liquid Ocelot's uprising, Solid Snake throws himself into his final battle.
The battle against Liquid and the Patriots draws to a close, and the mysteries woven throughout the series are now revealed!

【STORY】
THE TRANSFORMATION OF WAR INTO BUSINESS.
In an era where PMCs (private military companies) have risen to the top, war has become a business and the driving force behind the world economy. 

Controlling the top five PMCs from behind the scenes is Liquid Ocelot, who fanning the flames of war even further, plans an insurrection with the goal of creating a world where warriors can lead fulfilling lives—a goal shared by none other than Big Boss. 

Under the theme of “Sense” watch as the final battle of the man with Big Boss’s genes, Solid Snake, unfolds.

----------

Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots

[Digital Contents]

70010000070284.description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you avoid combat and complete missions while hiding.

The game take place 10 years after METAL GEAR SOLID 3: Snake Eater.
Amidst the swirling conspiracies behind the East-West Cold War, Snake confronts them while leading a private military force.
This is the story of how one soldier, “Snake”, becomes “Big Boss”.

【STORY】
THE ILLUSION OF PEACE FALTERS

In 1964, after saving the world from all-out nuclear war, Naked Snake, a true hero, receives the name Big Boss, but he disappears shortly after the naming ceremony.

Ten years later, Big Boss is running an independent military unit in Columbia, when he is visited by two individuals from Costa Rica, a country without a military.

In a post-Cuban Missile Crisis world, and in a Central America essential to maintaining the power balance between East and West, Costa Rica has been miraculously able to maintain peace.
However, a mysterious armed group has been seen acting suspiciously throughout the region.

They request Big Boss to investigate and eliminate the armed group.
Though he hesitates to accept the request because the tape they brought contained the voice of The Boss, who was supposed to be dead.

【System】
This title offers not only thrilling solo infiltration missions but also co-op with “SENYU” via online connections, and competitive multiplayer for up to six players.

The offshore facility Mother Base supports your missions.

It houses staff living quarters, development labs for mission weapons and gear, storage for captured large-scale weapons, and more. Expanding your staff allows Mother Base to grow and develop, incorporating simulation elements.

----------
The Screenplay Book containing in-game text from Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker and the Master Book detailing the story and characters are also included within the game.

70010000072292.description:
Guide four distinct knights through 100 brain-bending puzzle levels where the real danger isn't obstacles or enemies—it's the hungry mimic waiting for them at the end. Place directional tiles, springs, and boxes to steer your hapless adventurers toward treasure (and their inevitable doom), while keeping hazards from derailing the path to their delicious demise.

Featuring 100 challenging levels with three coins hidden in each, four knights with different personalities to master, multiple endings to uncover, and enough puns to make you groan. Plus a killer soundtrack.

• 4 knight types with unique mechanics
• 100 levels with secret coins to find
• 3 different endings
70010000072292.intro: Guide knights through brain-bending puzzles to their delicious doom
70010000072292.name: Chew Chew Mimic

70010000087202.description:
Aggelos 2 is an explosive action-platformer where lightning-fast combat, precision platforming, and two opposing worlds collide. As an Aggelos, the highest order of angels, you are chosen by Balro to venture through the Kingdom of Lumen, domain of the supreme God of Light. But with Lumen under siege and the Gods facing imminent defeat at the hands of the Army of Darkness, you are forced to embrace a shadowy new form to survive the chaos of both light and dark realms.

While your angelic side favors a slower, disciplined approach, your demon form is highly agile, aggressive, and bristling with dark powers. Mastering the shift between both forms is key to survival, and only by balancing order and chaos can you hope to overcome formidable enemies, deadly obstacles, and challenging puzzles along your path.

- Parallel realms: Explore two massive, overlapping maps, each with their own unique characteristics, enemies to fight, secrets to discover, and challenges to overcome.
- Dual Combat System: Switch between Angel and Demon forms to change the world and your playstyle, from precise defenses to fast assaults, mastering timing, strategy, and reflexes.
- Emerge victorious: Take on hordes of enemies and conquer 13 massive bosses across both realms. Steel yourself for memorable encounters that build on the original game’s signature battles.
- Puzzles of Discovery: Solve challenges by mastering skills, memorising routes, manipulating mechanisms, avoiding traps, and interacting with the world to reveal secrets and new paths.
- Grow your power: Collect orbs to unlock devastating special attacks, boost your strength and increase your survivability, adding a tactical layer to your progression.
- Evolve to survive: Unlock new skills as you progress, from flight and wall grabs to dashes and powerful special attacks, offering up new ways to explore and reach previously inaccessible areas.
- Stunning 16-bit Artwork: Striking pixel art and detailed sprites designed to complement smooth, fast-paced 2D gameplay.
70010000087202.intro: Two forms. Two realms. One epic adventure awaits.
70010000087202.name: Aggelos 2

70010000091997.description:
A Seaplane, a Storm, and a Missing Uncle 

Take to the skies in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After receiving a distress call from Uncle Lou, you arrive only to find the islands in disarray and Lou nowhere to be found. Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance. 

Collect, Craft, Restore 

Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler! — a glorious multi-tool — to collect everything from scrap and native plants to materials dropped by Limbo’s unique wildlife. Use your finds to repair buildings, craft goods, and help the communities thrive again. 

Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over.  

Meet the islanders of Limbo 

Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins!

Key Features: 

- Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 

- Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 

- Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 

- Personalize your seaplane with vibrant skins and custom configurations. 

- Full character customization. Make your avatar uniquely yours, from hairstyle to outfits and accessories. 

- Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 

- A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! 

Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure.  

Ready for takeoff?
70010000091997.name: Lou's Lagoon

70010000095262.description:
Step into the halls of a hospital filled with mystery, desire, and raw emotion. Meet irresistible nurses, each with their own unique charm, and protect them—not just from outside threats, but from the wounds they carry within.

Through intimate questions and emotionally charged strategy gameplay, unlock suggestive images and endings as intense as they are unexpected.

Each nurse hides more than her uniform reveals. Can you truly understand her heart… and win it?


Features:

● Unique dual gameplay: Switch between deep, revealing questions that uncover her soul and defense mode, where you must shield her heart from emotional tension and past regrets.

● Suggestive scenes and unforgettable moments: Unlock intimate images and meaningful encounters—experiences that only unfold if you truly connect with her.

● Discover her most human side: Each response unveils pieces of her personality, hidden desires, and the secrets behind her professional smile.

● Multiple endings: What happens between you and her depends on your intuition, your choices… and how well you read between the lines.

● A secret, daring question: Reach the final moment and unlock a scene that will change everything.


Can you heal her heart… while yours races faster with every heartbeat?

Dare to live a story where romance, desire, and medicine entwine… and no one leaves untouched.
70010000095262.intro: Uncover the secrets of the hospital… while healing the heart of your ideal nurse.
70010000095262.name: Medical Lab Science: Anime Nurse Love in the Public Hospital

70010000115888.description:
The long-awaited third installment in the Court of Darkness series is finally here!
Experience brand-new romance storylines with a fresh cast of consorts♪

■Story
The night of a crimson crescent moon,
you find yourself transported
to a realm called Saligia.

Far removed from your everyday life,
you're in a world where magic is commonplace.

In the midst of your confusion,
before you appear
five beautiful princes.

They crave the power
your kiss can bestow,
and will scheme to get it.

But what they seek
is not just your power.
They want your heart as well...

■Characters
Jasper Lane: The Inerrant Professional
Tino Maes: The Loyal Maladroit
Knight: The Brazen Ally
Grayson: The Steadfast Soldier

■Contents
Princes’ Path Books 1-3 (excluding Special Tales), plus Book 1 Consorts’ Paths for Jasper, Tino, Knight, and Grayson from the romance app Court of Darkness.
*Does not contain voice or avatar features.
70010000115888.intro: In this world of magic, your kiss is an irresistible temptation.
70010000115888.name: Court of Darkness: Adoration's Kiss

70010000119949.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Baekje Military Museum, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 1 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery. MasCon for Nintendo Switch™ made by Zuiki of Japan is also supported.
70010000119949.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Baekje Military Museum

70010000120315.description:
Play as Wigo, the Orc, whose wife has been kidnapped and taken up to the skies by a magic dress gifted by a mysterious Fairy.

As Wigo saw his wife going up to the skies, he went to the tallest building known on the continent: The Black Tower Enigma.

Inside the Black Tower Enigma, Wigo has to solve some riddles and challenges in order to climb up and find some clues to find his wife.

About levels

Each level is a small yet elaborate challenge that requires the player to use their intelligence and ability to decipher the riddles to advance through the Tower.

Also, Black Tower Enigma has an interesting background story, which is enriched inside the huge library scattered throughout each level of the tower.

Game features

- Elaborated puzzles, riddles, and hints along each level
- Interesting story discovered along each level
- Cool pixelated art-style
- Orchestral-designed music
- Simple and intuitive game play
70010000120315.intro: Puzzle-Solving Retro Adventure about an Orc inside a Mysterious Tower looking for his Wife.
70010000120315.name: Black Tower Enigma

70010000121572.description:
The Therian boys are untamed, magnetic, and not easy to read. They move on instinct, and the only way to get close is to prove you can keep up with them.

Take on Q&A rounds and hold your own in reflex minigame battles. Clear each challenge to unlock exclusive images in their gallery, one wild boy at a time.

Each guy has his own energy, his own edge, and his own way of warming up to someone he actually likes.

Which one is going to get under your skin first?


Features:

● MECHANICS THAT PUT YOU TO THE TEST: Q&A and reflex-based minigames trade off without warning. Answer smart, react fast, and keep moving.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Progress through each boy's arc to unlock exclusive gallery images saved just for you.

● DISTINCT PERSONALITIES: Every Therian boy reacts differently during gameplay, from encouraging to competitive to surprisingly tender when you least expect it.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How things end depends on how far you go. Some connections take time. Some surprises come early. Keep playing to find out.

● HIDDEN SPECIAL MOMENT: Hit question 150 and something different happens. You'll want to get there.


These boys don't open up for everyone. But for the right person, who puts in the effort and stays in the game, something real is waiting at the other end. 

Start playing and find out if that someone is you.
70010000121572.intro:
These guys are wild by nature. 
Get close, earn their trust, and unlock what they don't show just anyone.
70010000121572.name: Therian Crush: Wild Animal Boys

70010000123221.description:
You awaken in a labyrinth of interconnected rooms with no memory of how you got there - and no obvious way out. Every corridor leads to another mystery, every door hides a new challenge, and every mistake brings you closer to failure.
Solve clever environmental puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and search for the path to freedom before time runs out. The maze is constantly testing your observation, logic, and decision-making, forcing you to think quickly under pressure.
With each room you conquer, the exit feels closer... yet the labyrinth always has another surprise waiting. Stay focused, keep moving, and make every second count - because the clock never stops ticking.
70010000123221.name: Inside the Cube

70010000124110.description: Horripilant is a chilling incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld. Combining idler, puzzle and autobattler elements, you'll fight, mine, and think your way through the depths of a forsaken dungeon. With each step you'll grow stronger, but beware; every boon has its burden.
70010000124110.name: Horripilant

70010000124430.description:
Discover a Gothic world in this 2D top-down action-adventure, blending fast-paced combat, exploration, and pixel art inspired by retro classics. Fight monstrous foes, unlock new abilities, and explore a non-linear map filled with hidden secrets and dangerous challenges.

COMBAT

Master precise combat, where every strike and dodge matters. Manage your stamina as you face off against grotesque enemies. You have a limited number of healing flasks so use them wisely. Upgrade your character's stats to remain effective in combat.

TOOLS

Discover powerful new tools hidden in the dungeons that enhance both combat and exploration. Unlock new abilities to defeat enemies more effectively and access hidden paths, uncovering deeper secrets within the world.

DUNGEONS

Uncover hidden dungeons throughout Tearscape's dark, interconnected world. Each dungeon holds unique challenges, powerful items, and deadly enemies, pushing your combat and exploration skills to the limit.

BOSS FIGHTS

Face off against challenging bosses: massive, grotesque creatures born from dark experiments. Each encounter demands precise timing, strategy, and mastery of your abilities to emerge victorious.

EXPLORATION

Explore the vast, interconnected map filled with branching paths, hidden shortcuts, and secret areas. The non-linear design encourages exploration, rewarding you with powerful items and new abilities.

NPCs

Encounter a diverse cast of NPCs, some offering guidance, others seeking your help, and a few with their own hidden agendas. Every interaction adds depth to the story.
70010000124430.name: Tearscape

70010000125567.description:
Discover and record 90+ plants, creatures, and fish at various locations around Shimmerbrook, and contribute your findings to the Archive.

Features
- Tame and raise 32 unique creatures
- Observe wild plants and grow them as crops based on different requirements
- Meet over 20 townsfolk, attend town festivals, go on hangout events
- Date and marry one of the 10 romanceable candidates
- Dig deep into the mines, fish, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery behind Shimmerbrook
- Cook, craft, build, and more!

Your life as a researcher starts today!
70010000125567.intro: Tame creatures, grow crops, and record your findings!
70010000125567.name: Research Story

70010000125714.intro: Tour beautiful places and dance the Sardana with the hidden cats of Barcelona!
70010000125714.name: Hidden Cats in Barcelona

70010000127045.description:
Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring and fighting against human armed forces with various transformations, and annihilating the world. By continuously devouring humans to obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities can be added to combat human armed forces and eliminate the world. When encountering different extraterrestrial crystals, one can acquire different superpowers. And it can have different transformations in different situations, experiencing super destructive power.

This is a Roguelike game where players operate an alien monster to devour humans, obtaining dozens of weapons, shields, and more through the energy gained Buff、 Follow the ball, fire different energy bullets, and merge these bullets for firing. Different follower balls can also attack in different ways.

In the game, there are randomly encountered alien crystals that can acquire different superpowers, providing abilities such as freezing, fire breathing, and protective shields, making the game process more interesting.

In the game, you can also have different transformations and experience super destructive power. If it can transform into a super ape with invincible power, it can directly destroy houses and police cars in the city.

Players can choose different characters to play the game, and multiple maps are set up to confront humans in different environments. And designed a 6-level difficulty level, constantly challenging one's own abilities. The game features nearly a hundred achievements, requiring constant achievement in intense battles.

Players can continuously enhance their abilities, including health, health recovery, damage, attack speed, critical hit rate, etc., through the game's outsider cultivation function.
70010000127045.intro:
Devour and destroy the world.
Fighting against armed forces with various transformations.
Obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities.
70010000127045.name: Monst

70010000127383.description:
Golftacular! is mini-golf... barely. Mix party game chaos and dumb fun with precision and strategy.

Up to 4 players take turns as Tortillo, Chuck, Fin, Poop, Papa, Mama, Claude, and Frend, each one aiming for the hole while unleashing chaos on anyone foolish enough to stand in the way.

Enjoy endless replayability with dozens of handcrafted courses and thousands of possible item combos. Items shake up everything: turn the course into your personal parkour playground or an obstacle-filled nightmare for your opponents. Call in airstrikes, play rock-paper-scissors, give your ball wings, place portals... and that’s just the tip of the iceberg.


FEATURES

- Items, Items, Items - Use items for game breaking abilities and combos
- Ear Candy Radio - Bumping original sound track
- Express yourself - Pick from a cast of whackos... which one are you?
- Play it your way - Play with keyboard & mouse or controllers
- Not enough controllers? No Problem! - Pass and play mode lets you share
- No friends? No problem! - Tackle challenging courses alone in single player puzzles
70010000127383.intro: Mini-golf turned upside down! Abuse wild items on a variety of challenging golf tours. Shoot, fly, explode, and whatever else you can to get in the hole! It’s golf... barely.
70010000127383.name: Golftacular!

70010000127620.description:
Zumba – The Pharaoh’s Marble Revenge invites you into the golden age of Egypt, where a mystical scarab launcher guards the treasures of the ancients! Choose your path, aim enchanted orbs at winding desert tracks, and match three or more identical colors to trigger divine explosions before they breach the inner sanctum. Secure high scores and earn up to three stars per level by clearing waves with the precision of a master architect.
Between stages, spend your gathered gold to unlock powerful Egyptian relics:
Sunfire Flare: Scorches entire clusters with the heat of the desert sun.
Sands of Time: Slows the advancing orbs to a crawl.
Eye of Horus: Transmutes your next orb into any color you desire.
Anubis’ Rain: Summons a barrage of falling stones to create instant matches.
Obelisk Strike: Targets a single, stubborn orb for immediate destruction.
Eternal Echo: Undoes your last shot, offering a second chance at glory.
Journey through four legendary realms—the Verdant Nile Delta, the Gilded Giza Plateau, the Midnight Luxor Temple, and the Hidden Chamber of Duat. Every ten levels, the sands shift to reveal unique paths, new orb colors, moving obstacles, and escalating speeds.
Addictive and easy to learn but challenging enough to stump a Sphinx, Zumba – The Pharaoh’s Marble Revenge delivers timeless arcade fun for players of all ages.
70010000127620.intro: Awaken the Pharaoh’s curse—match, blast, and conquer the sands of time!
70010000127620.name: Zumba - The Pharaoh's Marble Revenge

70010000129100.description:
A short 3D exploration horror game set in a nostalgic Japanese countryside town.
Featuring multiple endings, with three different conclusions awaiting you.

●Story
Keita breaks his promise and visits a friend’s house while his mother is away for the day.

There, he begins to notice something unsettling about his mother.
A mysterious diary discovered at home… and the hidden secrets surrounding the house.

For some reason, his mother already knew that Keita had gone out to play.

And when she leaves again that night without returning, Keita sets out into the darkness to search for her...
70010000129100.intro:
I broke the promise I made to my mother and went to visit a friend’s house.
That was where it all began.
70010000129100.name: A Taste of Home

70010000130150.description:
Numbers and letters can tuck away some pretty clever rules. Can you work out what is going on before you lock in an answer?

It is easy to jump at the first option, but these quick puzzles reward a closer look, a bit of comparison and some clear thinking.

This is a text-based four-choice logic puzzle game with 40 stages to clear. Read the question, pick up the clues in the wording and choose the answer that best matches the hidden rule.

How to play:

・Read the question carefully
・Compare the four answer choices
・Select the option you think is right
・Review the explanation after answering

A correct answer gives you that nice aha feeling, and a wrong one still helps sharpen your reasoning for the next stage.

Great for a quick break, a casual brain workout, number puzzles, letter puzzles and bite-sized logic challenges.

Give your observation skills a run and try to clear all 40 stages!

Button and touch controls are supported, so you can play whichever way feels easiest.
70010000130150.intro: Can you nut out the pattern?
70010000130150.name: IQ Logic Codes: Number & Letter Puzzles

70010000130237.description:
Get ready to enter a world of clever inventions, smart challenges, and brilliant solutions in Magnetail. In this charming puzzle adventure, you follow an ingenious inventor mouse who transforms workshops, laboratories, and storage rooms into playgrounds of experimentation and discovery.

Each level presents a new challenge where energy, magnetism, and logic work together. Push energy modules, watch them slide across the environment, and use magnets strategically to redirect trajectories, create barriers, and open unexpected paths. It may seem simple at first, but you will quickly discover that every move can completely change the outcome of the puzzle.

The key is thinking several steps ahead. Where will the module stop? Which magnet should be used first? Which route leaves the path clear for the next move? In Magnetail, every decision matters, and finding the perfect solution is as satisfying as powering up a complex machine for the very first time.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels spread across busy workshops, experimental laboratories, and storage facilities filled with mechanical challenges. New situations constantly emerge, requiring observation, planning, and creativity to master the rules of magnetism and turn obstacles into opportunities.

With charming visuals, accessible controls, and puzzles that reward intelligence and experimentation, Magnetail delivers a relaxing, engaging, and highly rewarding experience. It is the kind of game that makes you stop, study the room for a moment, and then smile when the perfect solution finally clicks into place.

Align the modules, master the magnets, and prove that no invention is too complex for a brilliant mind.
70010000130237.intro: Think Like a Genius, Solve Like an Inventor
70010000130237.name: Magnetail

70010000130462.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.
70010000130462.name: Escape game R00M16

70010000130922.description:
Reckon you can bring a sparkling night scene back together with a few smart turns?

Set around a lively poolside after dark, this picture puzzle is all about restoring a photo that has been split apart.

Getting started is easy!
・Check the direction of the photo carefully
・Turn each slice to the correct orientation
・Use the flow of the whole image to complete one picture

The controls are straightforward, so you can jump in even if you are new to puzzles.
As you clear more stages, it becomes harder to rely on just one part of the photo. Background details, hair, outfits and lights all help test your eye for small clues.

Great for players who:
・Like photo puzzles and rotation puzzles
・Want quick puzzle sessions
・Prefer a focused solo challenge
・Enjoy colourful night views and resort vibes
・Like games built around observation and a bright idea

Enjoy the neon-lit night atmosphere and aim to finish every photo!

Playable with button controls or touch controls.
70010000130922.intro:
Give each shot a twist!
A neon night picture puzzle
Bring every photo back
70010000130922.name: Neon Beauties: HENTAI Photo Puzzle

70010000131219.description:
Take flight in your seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After a devastating storm, gather materials with your Swirler, and help the locals rebuild. Can you uncover the truth behind Uncle Lou’s disappearance?

A Seaplane, a Storm, and a Missing Uncle 

Take to the skies in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After receiving a distress call from Uncle Lou, you arrive only to find the islands in disarray and Lou nowhere to be found. Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance.

Collect, Craft, Restore 

Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler! — a glorious multi-tool — to collect everything from scrap and native plants to materials dropped by Limbo’s unique wildlife. Use your finds to repair buildings, craft goods, and help the communities thrive again. 

Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over.  

Meet the islanders of Limbo 

Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins! 

Key Features: 

- Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 
- Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 
- Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 
- Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 
- A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! 

Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure.  

Ready for takeoff?
70010000131219.name: Lou's Lagoon – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000131479.description:
Keen to find out which mythical creature matches your personality?

This easygoing, image-based quiz asks you a few simple questions, then points you towards the creature type that feels most like you.

Across the quiz, you will meet a range of legendary creatures with very different vibes, from bold and powerful to calm and mysterious. Your answers lead you to one of 16 personality types.

Playing is straightforward:

・Look at the picture and read the question
・Pick the answer that feels most like you
・Check your personality result

There are no right or wrong answers, and no fiddly controls to worry about. Read your result at your own pace, or have a go with family and mates to compare your types.

Great for fans of personality tests, fantasy themes, quick casual games and fun little chat starters.

What creature is hiding inside you? Go with your gut and discover your type from 16 possibilities.

Button controls and touch controls are both supported.
70010000131479.name: Mythical Creature Personality Quiz: 16 Types

70010000131650.description:
※Please note that this game does not support English.

Want to build useful English vocabulary before secondary school?

This is a light, friendly quiz game for learning basic English words that are handy to know while children are still in primary school.

How to play is simple:
・Look carefully at the picture
・Choose the matching English word from 4 options
・When you answer correctly, read a clear explanation

Even if you are not sure at first, take your time and compare the picture with the choices.

Get every question right and your English confidence may grow step by step. It is a fun way to get ahead in everyday learning.

Whether you dream of using English in the future or just want school study to feel a bit easier, why not start with a quick quiz today?

Button and touch controls are supported.
70010000131650.intro: Build first English words with a fun quiz!
70010000131650.name: Palabras en inglés para aprender en la primaria

70010000131735.description:
Welcome to Fernkeep, a cosy exploration game set within the walls of a peaceful medieval stronghold. Wander through towering castles, bustling courtyards, narrow cobblestone streets, hidden gardens, and ancient towers as you search for every unique location throughout the town.

Features:
>Explore a handcrafted medieval castle town.
>Discover every hidden location and secret area.
>Wander through castles, courtyards, markets, gardens, and towers.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>Immerse yourself in a peaceful medieval atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration.
70010000131735.intro: Discover the quiet charm of a medieval castle town.
70010000131735.name: Fernkeep

70010000131882.description:
Project City is a top-down open-city action game inspired by the chaotic feel of classic arcade crime sandboxes. Hit the streets in a drivable city full of traffic, pedestrians, shops, police, gangs, odd jobs, and escalating trouble.

Earn cash by running taxi fares, package drops, food deliveries, and risky crew work, or push your luck with ATM hacks and weapon shop visits. Slide into drift challenges, dodge police heat, avoid spike strips and roadblocks, and keep moving when the city turns against you. Every run is about choosing how far to hustle, how much chaos to cause, and whether you can survive long enough to cash out.
With fast driving, on-foot exploration, wanted levels, city events, weapons, interiors, leaderboards, and a sharp street-comedy tone, Project City is a compact urban mayhem sandbox built around simple controls and constant trouble.
70010000131882.intro: Drive, drift, hustle, and survive a city that reacts to every bad decision.
70010000131882.name: Project City

70010000132130.description:
Something uncanny has kicked off in places that look perfectly normal. Take in each scene and figure out which cursed object is causing the trouble.

Check the room, notice anything that feels off, and follow the clues left behind by the strange event. Think through the situation, then pick the object you reckon is behind the curse.

How to play:
・Observe the scene where the haunting happened
・Check suspicious items and clues
・Choose the cursed object you think is the cause and seal it

Even the most ordinary-looking thing might be hiding a truly nasty secret.

Rely on your observation and deduction skills to uncover the truth one puzzle at a time. Each challenge is quick to play, so it is great for a quiet solo session or for swapping theories with mates and family.

Recommended if you enjoy:
・Ghost stories and strange tales
・Mystery games and puzzles
・Picking out tiny odd details in illustrations
・Quick brain-training challenges
・Solving things together with family or friends

Can you uncover what is really behind each haunting and seal every cursed object correctly?

Playable with button controls or touch controls.
70010000132130.intro:
Reckon you can spot the curse?
Read the scene
Seal it away!
70010000132130.name: Cursed Objects: Find and Seal

70010000132205.description:
It looks like a plain black-and-white photo… but one little detail feels completely out of place.

People, rooms and streets from another time. A quiet moment caught on camera. A clue that should not exist in that era.
If time travel is happening somewhere we know nothing about, these photos might be the evidence left behind.

Take a good look, read the scenario, and uncover the unsettling truth hidden in the image.

・Read the situation and question
・Scan the photo for something that does not belong
・Select the suspicious evidence in the image
・See the reasoning after you answer

A great pick if you’re into urban legends, mystery puzzles, light horror, solo play and quick brain-teasers.
The more the photo makes sense, the creepier the truth becomes.

Play your way, with button controls and touch controls supported.
70010000132205.intro:
What’s wrong
with this old photo?
70010000132205.name: Hidden Photo Mysteries: The Truth Gets Scary

70010000132565.description:
Crayon Story: Thumbelina is a creativity-boosting game based on the classic fairy tale that children love. Beyond just playing, children can decorate scenes and complete stories in their own words, fostering a sense of accomplishment.


Key Features


Coloring: Touch the screen to fill scenes with vibrant colors. With intuitive controls, anyone can easily create their own masterpiece.


Writing: Write your own sentences to match the colored scenes. Your child's imagination brings a unique version of 'Thumbelina' to life.


Personal Gallery: Completed pages are saved in your gallery, so you can revisit and enjoy your custom storybook anytime.


Start a fun artistic journey with Crayon Story: Thumbelina by GaniTani!
70010000132565.intro: An emotional, creative children's game where you color your own storybook and write your own tales.
70010000132565.name: Crayon Story: Thumbelina

70010000133016.description:
One day, you’re just wandering down the track when you spot… a "neckless" giraffe?! Fair dinkum! Turns out, it's an incredibly rare new species whose neck grows over time. And guess what? It looks like the little mate has taken a real shine to you.

Right then, it's time to kick back and start your own relaxed, care-free life raising your very own special giraffe!

< How to live with your giraffe >
◆ Keep an eye on your giraffe's belly!
Your giraffe's hunger meter drops as time ticks by. To keep them happy and healthy, make sure to feed them some carrots so they don't miss out on their brekkie or tea!

◆ Harvest heaps of carrots in the mini-games!

Carrot Tower:
A balancing game where you stack carrots as high as you can. The higher the stack, the bigger the reward! But watch out—drop just one, and it's game over. Keep your focus and go for a high score!

Carrot Darts:
Take aim and chuck carrots at the target. Line up your shot and aim for the top score!

◆ Spend your earnings at the Shop!
Trade in the carrots you've collected for handy items. Grab "Mini-Game Tickets" or a "Name Tag" to give your giraffe a proper moniker. Stock up on helpful gear and become absolute best mates!
70010000133016.name: GIRAFFE RAISING GAME ~Reach for the sky~

70010000133083.description:
Keen for a chilled puzzle with just enough pressure to keep you on your toes ?

You know the feeling : the picture is almost right, but a few slices are still facing the wrong way.

In this illustration puzzle, each scene is split into rotating slices. Turn them back to the correct orientation, restore the original picture, and improve your time to earn up to 3 stars.

・Check the sliced illustration
・Rotate each slice one by one
・Put the picture back the right way
・Improve your time to aim for more stars

It is easy to pick up, quick to replay, and great for a relaxed break or a cheeky personal best attempt.

Take a good look, make your turns count, and bring every illustration back together.

Playable with button controls and the touch screen.
70010000133083.intro: Can you turn it all back?
70010000133083.name: Dreamy Beauties: Heart-Pounding Illustration Puzzle

70010000133458.description:
Word Hive 3 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global ranks, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Word Hive 3 uses an British English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 5,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all eight letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
70010000133458.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000133458.name: WordHive 3

70010000133555.description: Dungeons of Alethrion is a dungeon crawler roguelike game with randomly generated dungeons that get progressively more difficult. Choose to play from four different heroes, each with unique abilities. Try it single-player or grab a friend to join you in the dungeons!
70010000133555.intro: Enter the infinite dungeon and see how far you can go!
70010000133555.name: Dungeons of Alethrion

70010000134363.description:
Take a good look at photos set in a relaxing Japanese hot spring inn and try to remember every detail before time runs out!

From open-air baths and cozy guest rooms to elegant lounges and peaceful gardens, each scene is packed with details worth remembering.

How to play:
・Study the photo before time runs out
・Remember the people, poses, clothing, and objects around them
・Use your memory to take on the challenge

The simple gameplay makes it easy to jump in for a quick session. Enjoy the photos at your own pace while putting your memory and observation skills to the test.

Recommended for players who:
・Enjoy photo and memory games
・Like testing their observation skills
・Love Japanese inns and hot spring scenery
・Want something easy to play in short sessions
・Enjoy relaxing, glamorous photography

How much of each scene can you remember?
70010000134363.intro:
Memorize the perfect ryokan moment!
A quick photo memory challenge
How many details can you remember?
70010000134363.name: Hot Spring Beauties Japanese Inn Date Memory

State of Panic
Resurrection Core Edition continues to expand with new characters and new levels, delivered as part of the Season Pass. Each content drop introduces a new level alongside a new character to unlock and master, bringing fresh playstyles, abilities, and challenges to the game. 70050000075918.name: Lou's Lagoon Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70070000033352.description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.
This collection is the second installment of the definitive Metal Gear Master Collection.

Vol. 2 includes Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots and Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version).

Each game includes a Screenplay Book containing the text from the respective title, plus a Master Book offering detailed insights into the story and characters.

Also, as purchase bonuses for the collection edition, it includes METAL GEAR Ghost Babel—the series first title for handheld consoles, released in 2000—and Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2, featuring numerous iconic tracks that enhanced Snake's missions, ranging from BGM used in the games to vocal songs.

[Game List]
Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version)
Metal Gear: Ghost Babel

70070000033352.intro: The second installment of the collection featuring “Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots” and “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version)”
70070000033352.name: METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.2

70070000039155.description:
Build, renovate, decorate, and organize with the ultimate home design collection.

This bundle includes two games, each offering its own unique take on creating beautiful living spaces.

Restore neglected houses in Fix & Flip Dream House by renovating interiors, choosing new finishes, placing furniture, and transforming outdated properties into stunning modern homes. Then continue your creative journey in Unboxing: Cozy Home Simulator, where you'll unpack belongings, organize every room, and decorate warm, inviting spaces filled with personality and charm.

Whether you enjoy large-scale home renovations or the relaxing satisfaction of organizing and decorating cozy interiors, this bundle offers countless hours of creative gameplay. Design stylish rooms, personalize every detail, and experience two relaxing home-building adventures in one complete collection.
70070000039155.name: Flipper & Unboxing House 2-in-1

70070000039341.description:
Build your automotive empire and prove your skills behind the wheel with the ultimate driving and dealership collection.
This bundle includes two games that let you experience both sides of the automotive world. Build a successful car dealership by buying, selling, upgrading, and expanding your business, then put your vehicles to the test in a rewarding parking simulator packed with challenges, customization, and progression.
Grow your showroom, unlock new cars, expand your garage, and master increasingly demanding driving objectives. Whether you're negotiating the perfect deal, customizing your favorite vehicles, or aiming for flawless parking, every achievement brings you one step closer to becoming a true automotive expert.
From running a thriving dealership to perfecting every maneuver, this collection delivers hours of satisfying simulation, progression, and driving fun.
70070000039341.name: Car Sales & Parking Bundle

70070000039502.description:
Test your instincts across three unique adventures where every decision can mean the difference between survival and failure.

This bundle includes three games, each delivering a different challenge. Escape from a heavily guarded prison using patience and clever planning, survive aboard a crippled ship abandoned after a brutal pirate attack, and investigate a mysterious hospital where reality itself cannot be trusted.

Every experience places you under constant pressure. Search for vital resources, solve environmental challenges, uncover hidden secrets, and make difficult decisions while facing unpredictable dangers. Whether you're managing scarce supplies, plotting the perfect escape, or carefully observing your surroundings for subtle anomalies, success depends on your ability to stay calm, think ahead, and adapt to changing situations.

Blending survival, stealth, exploration, and psychological horror, this collection offers three distinct stories united by one common theme: overcoming impossible odds. Every location presents new threats, every objective demands careful planning, and every victory feels earned.

Do you have what it takes to survive, escape, and uncover the truth?
70070000039502.intro: Face the unknown, escape the impossible.
70070000039502.name: Big Survival Collection 3-in-1

70070000039527.description:
Push your limits and dominate the asphalt in Speedway Legends: Overdrive Racing, a high-octane experience where speed, precision, and style define your legacy. Master intense modes like Drift, Circuit, and Time Attack, unleash powerful Overdrive boosts, and build the ultimate racing machine to outpace every rival.

This bundle includes the main title and the Money Boost DLC, giving you an instant cash injection to accelerate your journey to the top. Upgrade your cars, fine-tune performance, unlock powerful vehicles, and customize your ride with ease. Gain the advantage you need to compete at the highest level and leave your rivals behind.

Strap in, hit the gas, and become the legend every racer fears.
70070000039527.name: Speedway Legends Premium Edition

70010000107519.description:
A squad of mutant kids from the hood is humanity’s last hope in this colorful, humor-packed zombie apocalypse. Blast freaky zombies with ridiculous guns, spray wild graffiti across the city, and face a monstrous Zombie Boss at the end of every mission.

Each hero in the squad offers a unique playstyle: choose yours, dig the weirdest guns out of dumpsters, and enjoy the insane headshot animations.

THE SQUAD

Four young mutants, each with their own powers and playstyle, ready to blast some zombies! Pick your favorite (or the one with the collest look) and go wild!

FIND CRAZY GUNS

A Ketchup Blaster, a Gumball Shooter, a Shark-Head Shotgun, and even a Witch’s Broom, you’ll find all sorts of crazy guns to make zombies deeply regret their life (and death) choices.

KILL FREAK ZOMBIES

The writer definitely went off the rails here. Expect cute puppy zombies, tentacle-armed chonks, jacked-up cop zombies, and even an  Frankenstein with underwear. It doesn’t make much sense, but hey, it’s hilarious.

GRAFFITI THE WALLS

Painting graffiti in a zombie apocalypse isn’t easy. Every time you try to tag a wall, you might just summon an entire horde of the undead. Art has never been so dangerous (or colorful)!

DEFEAT THE ZOMBIE BOSS

This zombie clearly had a different breakfast. It’s stronger, meaner, and keeps coming back stronger each time. Beat the Boss Zombie and show it who’s the real monster here!
70010000107519.intro: Turn freaky zombies into a green goo explosion with a bunch of crazy guns and graffiti the walls while you try to save the city!

70010000125264.description:
The Immortal John Triptych is the ULTIMATE anthology of the Joe Richardson games. Four Last Things, The Procession to Calvary, and Death of the Reprobate are brought together under one glorious sun with never-before-seen deleted scenes, updated language parity across all three titles, an expanded soundtrack by Eduardo Antonello with new original recordings, manual saves for Four Last Things, backflips in The Procession to Calvary, and a button to trigger a superfluous trumpeted fanfare whenever you need to celebrate. Embrace the absurd, the profound, and the sweet soothing aesthetic of the Renaissance in The Immortal John Triptych.

Immortal John is dying. A holy war has ended in chaos. Sin itself demands reckoning. Three interconnected tales unfold across a world built from Renaissance paintings and Classical music, where the ridiculous and the profound collide. 

Help locals with their daily tasks, only to find the Devil lurking in the shadows. Chase a tyrant across kingdoms while assisting inept magicians and negotiating with God Almighty. Navigate sin, death, judgement, heaven and hell, all topped with a cherry of gleeful flippancy. 

From quiet countryside kindness spiraling into madness, to holy vengeance wrapped in absurdity, to cosmic philosophy delivered with a wink and a nudge, The Immortal John Triptych proves that the most intelligent thing you can do is embrace the utterly ridiculous.

Feature List:
• Puzzling Pilgrimages – A traditional narrative adventure game, with a modernised interface. Control your character(s) via direct control, interact with people and places with a snazzy 'verb coin' interaction menu, and drag and drop (or hoard) your precious items from a simple drop-down inventory.
• Renaissance Artwork – Renaissance, Rococo and even a hint of Romanticism, to be a little more precise. Hundreds of paintings, spanning hundreds of years, are all brought together into one consistent world.
• Classical Music – A mix of publicly available classics and works from musician Eduardo Antonello populate the Triptychs airwaves. Period appropriate music that adapts as the story progresses, recorded using real medieval/renaissance instruments.
• Standalone Story – Four Last Things,The Procession to Calvary, and Death of the Reprobate feature unique stories with recurring characters/themes all within the same world.
•  Highbrow Buffoonery – Lofty subject matter is treated with gleeful flippancy. Gags about butts are taken very seriously. But rest assured, while some of the jokes may be ridiculous, the puzzles make perfect sense! (or at least adhere to a consistent internal logic)
• Fully Remastered – Unified UI overhaul across the board, never-before-seen deleted and bonus scenes, QoL improvements, full controller support, and an arm in the air waving like it just doesn’t care. The Immortal John Triptych brings the ultimate Joe Richardson experience to the forefront.
• 4 WIP Time-Lapse Videos - Watch the painstaking process of transforming beautiful Renaissance classics into playable scenes, revealing the artistic techniques and creative genius behind the game’s unique visual style
• A few more bits and bobs
70010000125264.intro: Three Pythonesque adventures made from Renaissance paintings and reckless ambition. Explore luscious landscapes and preposterous portraits in this silly, smart trilogy.
70010000125264.name: The Immortal John Triptych

70010000126998.description:
You play as Secret Agent Mike Rogers, assigned to track down and capture the fugitive terrorists known only as the Velvet Twins. Set in 1960s you’ll fight through unforgettable stages from neon-lit Las Vegas, gritty Chinatown, and abandoned factories, all the way to a shootout in a Wild West village!

He can take down enemies with his bare hands, but when things get serious, he'll grab whatever weapons are available. He can use pistols, swords, baseball bats and even a submachine gun.

1964: Operation Velvet Twins delivers pure retro fun with no filler just tight gameplay, explosive action, and an unmistakable 8-bit flavor.


Features
* Play as Mike Rogers, secret agent !
* Punch your way through waves of enemies!
* Pick up firearms when the mission gets intense!
* Use a variety of mele weapons: swords, bats, crates, and more!
* Defeat 8 eccentric bosses!
* Fight across 7 unique locations!
* Retro visuals and music in authentic 8-bit style!
* Collect dollars to spend them on power-ups or save them to raise your score!
70010000126998.intro: A thrilling 2D spy adventure set in the 1960s.
70010000126998.name: 1964 Operation Velvet Twins

70010000127039.description:
Drifting isn’t about speed — it’s about control, flow, and style.

Step into a relaxed yet skill-based drifting experience where every corner is an opportunity to build momentum and score. Set across snowy tracks with a clean low-poly aesthetic, the game focuses on smooth driving, precision, and maintaining long, controlled drifts.

Chain together turns, control your angle, and keep your speed to build higher scores. The closer you get to obstacles and the longer you hold your drift, the more rewarding each run becomes. Every mistake breaks your flow, so staying focused is key.

Use handbrake turns to initiate drifts and nitro boosts to maintain speed through long curves. As you progress, unlock new cars with different handling styles and explore new locations designed to challenge your control and creativity behind the wheel.

Key Features:
	•	Drift System: Earn points through angle, speed, and control
	•	Smooth Arcade Handling: Easy to learn, challenging to master
	•	Nitro & Handbrake Mechanics: Extend drifts and maintain flow
	•	Multiple Cars: Unlock vehicles with unique driving feel
	•	Snowy Environments: Clean low-poly tracks with atmospheric design
	•	Progression System: Earn rewards, unlock locations, and improve performance
Art of Drift – Cozy Drift Simulator delivers a satisfying drifting experience where precision, timing, and style define every ride.
70010000127039.intro: Feel the drift, not the rush
70010000127039.name: Art of Drift – Cozy Drift Simulator

70070000037816.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!

70070000037870.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con™ Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con™ Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges!

• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller

- 16 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.
70070000037870.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000037870.name: Moto Rush GT Throne Edition

70070000037881.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

Conquer your enemies in the wild west style!
70070000037881.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Enhanced Edition

70070000038090.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 and expansion pack #3 with:

6 stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.
70070000038090.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000038090.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Superior Edition

70070000039353.description:
Get ready for the craziest and most fun action-platforming combo! Weird Heroes: Jump & Fun Bundle brings together four of the most unusual protagonists in gaming in one unrepeatable collection. Warp gravity in a prehistoric clay world with Crosak, defend the mafia's city against space invaders in Timothy vs the Aliens, discover an underground world full of lights and shadows in Naught, and lead a wild squad of flightless birds in Flying Soldiers. 

Jump, shoot, solve puzzles, and experience four unique adventures filled with humor and challenges!

Crosak
Turn your world around and join Crosak on his Jurassic adventure in a multi-gravity playdough universe. Play solo or with a friend and rescue the cavemen from the mighty Double G.

Timothy vs the Aliens
Gangsters don't share their city with anyone, especially not aliens! Control Timothy in this open-world platforming adventure. Defend the monochrome streets of Little Fish City by blasting colorful alien invaders. Drive classic cars, slow down time, and show them who is the King of the town.

Naught
Test your skills, take control of the environment, and guide Naught through deep underground labyrinths full of challenges, hidden places and secrets.

Flying Soldiers
Get ready to command an odd squad of fun birds and devise a plan to bring them safe and sound to the end of the battlefield. An outlandish puzzle game that will challenge your mind to make these greenhorn recruits into brave soldiers.
70070000039353.intro: Action, puzzles, and gravity-defying jumps! Join four unusual heroes in one crazy and fun platforming bundle.
70070000039353.name: Weird Heroes: Jump & Fun Bundle

70010000119248.description:
Jonas wakes up in the middle of the night to the sound of gunfire coming from the neighbouring farm.

Concerned, you decide to investigate, only to discover that your worst nightmare has become reality.

Zombie Arise is a tribute to the classic zombie FPS games of the 1990s, delivering an authentic retro experience.

Explore a variety of environments, eliminate hordes of zombies, and gather valuable resources.

Follow the radio transmission and fight your way out of the hell known as the zombie apocalypse!
70010000119248.intro: Zombie Arise is a retro zombie FPS inspired by classic console games from the 1990s.
70010000119248.name: Zombie Arise

70010000122211.description:
The Shark series, created by legendary Japanese studio Toaplan, is a landmark shoot 'em up series. Flying Shark (1987), which was well received for its simple rules and exquisitely tuned difficulty level, had a tremendous impact on vertical scrolling shoot 'em up games. 
The sequel Fire Shark (1989), with its screen-filling weaponry, set arcades ablaze with its destructive carnage!

For veteran shooters and new pilots 
In addition to the authentic "Arcade Mode" which is a faithful recreation of the original's rock-hard gameplay, both titles include a "Super Easy Mode" that allows even genre newcomers to enjoy the games.

Support functions and intel
The game is packed with a variety of features that help the player. The M2 gadgets displayed on the left and right of the playing field alert the player of enemies appearing from blind spots, the location of hidden features, what the next item will be, and other things that help you improve your chances of surviving the barrage of enemies.

Be an arcade hero
Includes the popular Arcade Challenge mode from the M2ShotTriggers! Each stage is divided into small areas to enhance your training, and a rewind function to make things even more efficient!
With practice comes perfection; a one-credit clear can be yours!
70010000122211.intro:
Beasts of the Sea, Soaring through the Skies!
Shoot 'em up arcade classics Flying Shark and Fire Shark together at last!
70010000122211.name: Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark

70010000125166.description:
Drifting in the silence of space, you awaken aboard a damaged orbital station. Systems are failing, oxygen is running low, and every sound echoes through cold metal corridors. This isn’t a story about conquering space—it’s about surviving it.

Explore the station in zero gravity, restore critical systems, and keep yourself alive against the odds. Repair broken modules, manage life support, and craft essential tools using limited resources. Every action matters, and every mistake brings you closer to the end.

Guided by a small AI drone, you’ll navigate through a tense and atmospheric environment where isolation, danger, and discovery go hand in hand.

Key Features:

• Monitor oxygen levels and maintain life support systems
• Repair damaged modules, pipelines, and power nodes
• Perform hands-on mini-games to restore station functionality
• Navigate and control movement in zero gravity
• Collect resources and craft essential survival tools
• Manage limited supplies while exploring the station

Stay focused, manage your resources, and fight to survive in the cold emptiness of space.
70010000125166.intro: Can you keep the station alive long enough to save yourself?
70010000125166.name: Astronaut Simulator

70010000132876.description:
My Friendly Little Island Deluxe is part of the GB Archive, a curated initiative focused on the technical preservation and distribution of homebrew games.

Life on the island starts slow. You walk, you talk, you help out where you can.

Every new upgrade changes the island around you. Ledges you used to walk around become shortcuts, long detours turn into single jumps.

Help the people you meet and they'll settle into your village, with the soundtrack growing livelier every time someone moves in. Change your look with cosmetic items, watch the island shift from day to night.

Plus a truly unreasonable number of coconuts.

A nostalgic experience that can also be played in vertical mode with touch controls to better match the '90s feeling! A full-color island, from sunrise to sunset.
70010000132876.intro: A sunny little island, a handful of new friends, and all the coconuts you can carry.
70010000132876.name: My Friendly Little Island Deluxe

70010000133437.description:
After being pulled through a mysterious portal, a brave little frog finds itself in a strange new world far from home. The only way back is to restore the ancient portal by finding the three hidden Power Gems scattered across the land.

Explore a vibrant world filled with colorful forests, peaceful rivers, sunny hills, hidden caves, and secret pathways as you search for each gem. Along the way, collect coins, uncover hidden areas, and enjoy a fun, relaxing adventure packed with exploration!

Features:
>Explore a colorful handcrafted world.
>Find the three hidden Power Gems to restore the portal.
>Collect coins scattered throughout the adventure.
>Discover secret paths and hidden locations.
>Enjoy a fun, family-friendly exploration experience.
>Relax with a charming cartoon-inspired adventure.
70010000133437.name: Frogborne: New Lands

70050000078763.description:
You must own the digital download version of Flying Fire Shark in order to play the content of this DLC.

This DLC adds the console versions of Flying Shark and Fire Shark. Experience the differences between the console versions and the original arcade versions. The NES version of Sky Shark (based on Flying Shark) recreates the effects of the arcade version with ingenuity, and the boldly rearranged music is a like a gust of fresh wind as you take to the skies. The Mega Drive version of Fire Shark provides a lower difficulty level, making it easier to play compared to the arcade original.

The DLC also includes Wardner, an action platformer first released in the arcades in 1987. Using fire magic to defeat enemies, the player receives money which can be used to buy items that helps them advance further into the insidious forest. Deep inside lurks the evil boss Wardner, who captured a young girl and turned her into a crystal ball. Can you save the fair maiden?

The following games will be added to the base game with this DLC:
• Sky Shark (NES version released in 1989) 
• Fire Shark (Japanese Mega Drive version released in 1990)
• Fire Shark (English Mega Drive/Genesis version released in 1990)
• Wardner (Japanese arcade version released in 1987)
• Wardner (International arcade version released in 1987)
• Pyros (North American version of Wardner released in 1987)
• Wardner (Japanese FDS version released in 1988)
70050000078763.intro: Console versions of Flying Shark and Fire Shark, and the action platformer Wardner.
70050000078763.name: Flying Fire Shark Console versions + Wardner DLC

70010000112590.description:
A STORM IS COMING

Forest of Deceit is a Jackbox-esque social deduction game for 4 to 8 players. You are part of a group lost in a dark, treacherous forest that seems to go on forever and ever. You can’t find any escape, and there’s a storm brewing on the horizon - a storm so massive that you all will surely perish if you can’t build a solid shelter before it arrives. Every day you explore the forest to gather resources with which to build your shelter. But the forest itself is cursed, slowly driving people into a traitorous madness; it’s surely already got a hold on some of your friends’ minds… or maybe even yours. If you don’t figure out who’s sabotaging the efforts to build a shelter, you all are going to be swept away. On the other hand, if you happen to be the Traitor and they find you, you could get kicked out of the group - for good.


A FOREST OF LIES AND BETRAYAL

From the minds of Ghost Camp and Thomas Mackinnon (creator of THE CORRIDOR and It Takes a War) comes Forest of Deceit, a back-stabbing experience about trying to survive a storm and betraying your friends. With a beautiful hand-drawn art style and a focus on casual play and social interaction, this party game is perfect for all kinds - from teenagers to grandpas, hardcore players to someone who’s never played a game in their life.

Each day, gathering parties are assigned to go deep into the forest for resources. Innocents will try to gather useful resources whereas Traitors will try to hinder the group’s advances with bad resources and try to get other players lost in the accursed woods. When the results of the day’s gathering are revealed, the group can discuss what happened - and after a few days there will even be a daily vote to expel suspected Traitors from the group. If the Innocents can build the shelter in time, they win! If not… it’s a victory for treachery.

Focusing on casual play and social interaction, Forest of Deceit is fun for all kinds of players - from a family experience to group meetings; from non-gamers to hardcore players!


FEATURES

- Gather resources to build a shelter against the upcoming storm. If you are a Traitor, you will try to get other people lost in the forest, and hinder the group’s efforts by collecting bad resources. 

- Discuss what happened, and eventually start voting suspect Traitors out. If the Traitors can prevent the Innocents building a shelter in time, they win.

- Create your own house rules: An endlessly replayable party game, with fully customisable game options. 

- Use your own phones, tablets, or computers for each player to play right from their very own web browser.

- Fantastic for both local multiplayer and online play. Works great with screen-sharing for online play!

NOTE: No generative AI was used in the making of this game or its associated assets.
70010000112590.intro: Find the Traitors in this social deduction Jackbox-esque game for 4-8 players.
70010000112590.name: Forest of Deceit

70010000116769.description:
The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, towns, and more! 

Follow wandering ex-soldier, Tets Kinoshta, as he overcomes intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

Features

"Bump the World!" with intuitive Bumpslash Combat. Walk into enemies to attack - no button needed! Fast-paced action levels AND exploration-and-lore focused levels will test your skills.

A vast world map you can search to find levels and zones. Follow your instincts to chart a flexible path. Go at your own pace — follow your spirit!

Fierce and uniquely designed bosses and enemies that will test your Bumpslash skills. Face vicious and hilarious tricks guarding the Fae's ancient secrets! 

Plenty of levels, each offering glimpses into the Fae, Angels and Humans living together in the country of Era.

Haunting lore, woven from Irish mythology, early Christian philosophy, and Japanese American history.

Mix up combat with subweapons and a gun, and visit towns to shop for items. Beat levels to get Scales and level up!

On average, a first playthrough takes 15-30 hours, depending on how much of the world you want to explore and how fast you play.
