Low-difficulty setting for Beginner Bumpslashers, and nightmarish settings for the deranged!
70010000116769.intro: Explore a secret-filled land in this 3D Action-Adventure, where every surprising level is hidden in plain sight! Travel and fight through a vast, unmarked overworld!
70010000116769.name: Angeline Era

70010000119035.description:
Start your engines and get ready to climb your way to the top of the motorsports world! Super Woden Rally Edge is a spin-off of the critically acclaimed Super Woden saga of racing games, blending classic arcade essence with technical depth and a genuine love of car culture. Inspired by genre classics but sporting a personality all its own, Super Woden Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond strict realism.

Navigate using an intuitive overworld map interface and collect a vast variety of vehicles, from the smallest and humblest to unstoppable hill-climb machines. Buy, sell, upgrade and customize cars in your garage, show off your photography skills in photo mode, record your times and try to beat other players’ records. Enjoy a multitude of environments with different terrain and weather conditions to negotiate, all set to an original soundtrack and presented with unique stylized visuals!

• Climb the ranks of the motorsports world in arcade-style rally events!
• Race the clock to claim podium positions.
• Use your winnings to buy new cars, customize and upgrade!
• Explore using an old-school world map interface.
• Check stats, take photos of your cars, listen to music and more between races!

This game and the content contained therein is not authorized by car manufacturers or motor racing competitions and there is no association thereof.
70010000119035.intro: Race for the top in a rally-focused arcade spin-off to the popular Super Woden series!
70010000119035.name: Super Woden Rally Edge

70010000133375.description:
A nomad wanders the far reaches of an overgrown megastructure, a world built for a forgotten purpose in which countless civilizations have lived entombed for ages.

But when the mech they use to traverse its vast distances breaks, they remain stranded in its hostile wilds beneath a concrete sky.

- - -

Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game that can be finished in a single sitting (one to three hours).

Explore architectual relics of eras near and long gone, meet mysterious and powerful factions that have emerged inside the megastructure, and fight your way through varied encounters in this tight and compact FPS campaign.

FEATURES:
- A short, tightly designed shooter campaign.
Unique setting filled with massive industrial structures taken over by nature.
- Atmospheric visuals inspired by mid-00s games.
- Responsive movement and combat.
- A sci-fi mystery story revealed through exploration of the game's spaces.
- An injury system that asks you to manage not only your health, but also your individual body parts.
- Multiple modifiers to change up your playthrough, from health system modifiers to enemy and item randomizers.
70010000133375.intro: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.
70010000133375.name: Metal Garden

70010000102737.description:
Players can choose from a cast of quirky and adorable characters to race through item-filled, obstacle-packed courses. Local multiplayer supports up to 4 players, while online multiplayer supports up to 8 players, ensuring fun and frantic competition.

■ Story: The story unfolds differently depending on the character you choose. Defeat all opponents across 10 stages to clear the game.
※ Even if you lose, don’t be discouraged—you can always try again.

■ Battle Run: Enjoy competitive races with 2 to 4 players by splitting the screen into 1 or 4 sections. The player who reaches the finish line first wins.

■ Time Attack: A single-player mode where the goal is to reach the finish line as quickly as possible. Challenge your limits by breaking your own records. You can also race against a ghost of your previous record to motivate yourself to improve.

■ Engacho (Chasing game): The character with the "poop" on their head becomes the chaser. You win by chasing down and touching other players. Supports 1 to 4 players.

■ Online Battle: Up to 8 players can enjoy either “Battle Run” or “Pofun Battle” together. Each game room can hold up to 8 players, and stages are chosen at random.

■ Rhythm Game: Hit the corresponding inputs for each colored Pofun as they align with the judgment line. Depending on your accuracy, the text, effects, and character reactions will change. Combos and accuracy are displayed on the screen, and Fever Mode triggers special effects. Enjoy the rhythm game with colorful and exciting music!

■ High Scoreboard: A mode where you can check players’ top scores in ranking order.

■ Game Settings: Choose the language and screen mode, adjust sound volume and control style. You can also enable shadow silhouettes when objects obscure characters, or turn on vibration feedback.
70010000102737.intro: Hashire HEBEREKE: EX is a modern remake of the 1994 Hashire HEBEREKE by SUNSOFT.
70010000102737.name: Hashire HEBEREKE: EX

70010000107437.description:
A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and all the animals have suddenly started dancing, leaving chaos in their wake! The creature behind this crazy beat is none other than the Mummy Queen, back from the Land of the Dead with her minions to play a cursed concert with a calamitous crescendo.

Help the Marsupilamis save Palombia from the Mummy Queen and her minions! 

A Fast-Paced 2D Platformer
Journey through four vibrant worlds in this high-energy platformer!
From the colourful jungle to the bustling city, find the clues to the Mummy Queen's hideout. Take on increasingly more intense challenges leading to the ultimate showdown against the Mummy Queen. 

3 Marsupilamis, 3 Abilities
Master the unique abilities of each Marsupilami. Switch characters to soar through the air, punch enemies, or leap across obstacles, and explore the different levels' secrets. Choose your Marsupilami wisely, and you might uncover a hidden level!

Experience the Adventure Together in Local Co-Op
Play the adventure with a friend or on your own and take on the Battle Dojos' challenges and the competitive minigames designed for friendly rivalries.

Dive Into a Vibrant, Colourful Universe Faithful to the Marsupilami Licence
Explore unforgettable environments, face memorable bosses, and uncover hidden levels, all set within a fast-paced, fun atmosphere for the whole family.
70010000107437.intro: Will you be able to follow the rhythm… or fall victim to the cursed dance?
70010000107437.name: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia

70010000117126.description:
Flyknight tells the tale of a squire of the order of the Flyknights who is assembled to vanquish the witch Lunamoth and lift her curse, which is preventing the denizens of the realm from growing wings. Now separated after an ambush, the squire arriveth at the village of the swamp folk and pledges to see the mission through, either alone or teaming up with other fighters summoned to help along the way.

Do you have what it takes to emerge victorious and claim Knighthood?
70010000117126.intro: Explore, fight, loot and fish! Solo or in co-op mode in this Old School First Person Dungeon Crawler.
70010000117126.name: FlyKnight

70010000117748.description:
"Growing up is mandatory. Becoming boring isn't.

Play as Lace, a rebellious teenager who refuses to fit into a world of rules, order and boring authority. Armed with a swing and a pile of shoes, they'll challenge anyone trying to tell them who to become.

Swing, aim and fling your shoes through handcrafted physics puzzles. It looks simple, but every level demands creativity, precision and perfect timing.  Master the perfect throw to SHOE IT ALL!

CHALLENGE THE ESTABLISHMENT!

Outsmart grumpy neighbors, rule-obsessed adults and greedy bosses in a colorful world where every obstacle is another chance to cause a little chaos.

PLAY YOUR WAY!

Complete levels your way. Every puzzle rewards experimentation, not just one correct solution. Discover creative shortcuts, land impossible trick shots and find smarter solutions with fewer throws.

SPEEDRUN OR EXPLORE!

Race for your fastest time in Speedrun Mode, or slow down to uncover hidden paths, bonus levels and every collectible.

Features 
65+ handcrafted physics puzzles with multiple solutions
Nearly 200 collectible stickers to complete your journal
Creative trick shots and satisfying chain reactions
Increasingly challenging levels that reward mastery
Dedicated Speedrun Mode
Hidden bonus levels packed with secrets
Memorable bosses in a comic-inspired world
High-energy punk soundtrack"
70010000117748.intro: Master impossible throws and challenge a world that takes itself too seriously.
70010000117748.name: Shoe It All!

70010000118644.description:
The world needs you!

Your mission is to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace to the world. You have to find your way through all parts of the scattered islands; complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and discover the truth behind the islands. Will you be able to return the nine primordial instruments?

Features
Enjoy the beautifully hand-drawn music themed graphic style
Play as 4 different characters, each with their own unique set of abilities
Fight 9 unique bosses, inspired by a specific musical instruments 
Switch to local co-op to form a team with up to 4 friends at any time
70010000118644.intro: AereA is a music-themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido’s disciples and explore Aezir
70010000118644.name: AereA

70010000122888.description:
Criminal Hearts puts you on rooftops at 3am, in back rooms where deals go sideways, and across the table from three men who should scare you.

They don't.

One of them doesn't talk. One of them talks too much. One tells you exactly what he is and dares you to stay anyway.

Every line you choose either pulls him closer or shuts the door for good. Your companion has your back and tells you the truth, but the risk is yours to take.

Say the right thing and he lets something slip he's never told anyone. Push too hard and he's gone before you can fix it.

Three men. Three ways this ends. None of them planned on you.


Features:

● ONE WRONG WORD CHANGES EVERYTHING: Trust here is earned slowly and lost instantly.

● THREE MEN WORTH THE RISK: Each one guards something different, and none of them hand it over.

● DARK ROMANCE VISUAL NOVEL: Cinematic, heavy, and built on choices that stick.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Redemption, ruin, or something a lot closer to obsession.

● A COMPANION IN YOUR CORNER: Reads the room, calls you out, never lies to you.


Three men nobody has ever gotten close to.

You're not here to be careful.

Get close.
70010000122888.intro:
Some men come with a warning. 
You've never been good at listening.
70010000122888.name: Criminal Hearts: Obsession Bad Boys Dating Sim

70010000126355.description: Fun pinball style battles. Attack the military camps of the holy Roman Empire and crush the legionaries. Choose the right trajectories to inflict as much damage as possible. Shoot down enemies, blow up barrels and collect coins. Free the map from these lazybones!
70010000126355.intro: The most unusual pinball you can find!
70010000126355.name: Vikings Pinball

70010000127987.description:
The year is 2099. The line between reality and the virtual world has disappeared.

Step into a fully immersive virtual world powered by cutting-edge Full-Dive technology. Join investigator Rapid and genius hacker Lena as they uncover the truth behind a mysterious series of incidents.

Veiled Edge is a 2D action-adventure combining fast-paced combat, detailed pixel art, and diverse gameplay styles. Master platforming and intense battles while using hacking abilities to alter the environment, reveal hidden paths, and overcome challenging stages.

Each chapter introduces unique settings and gameplay mechanics, offering fresh experiences throughout your journey. Explore cyberpunk cities, theme parks, research facilities, and more as you battle powerful enemies and bosses to expose a massive conspiracy.

Features
Beautiful pixel-art cyberpunk world
Fast-paced 2D action and platforming
Hack the environment to solve puzzles and progress
Unique gameplay in every chapter
Story-driven sci-fi mystery
Hidden routes and optional challenges to discover
70010000127987.intro: A 2D action-adventure set in a stunning pixel-art cyberpunk world.
70010000127987.name: Veiled Edge

70010000128414.description:
In Junkyard Builder: King Of Scrap, the ultimate version to experience the game,  you’re the proud owner of a once-forgotten junkyard, now brimming with endless potential. Dive into the satisfying world of restoration, recycling, and raw hustle as you transform trash into treasure and rise to become the ruler of the junk empire!

Hunt for Treasure: Drive to new locations and explore the world for rare finds.

Make Money & Upgrade: Make the most of the items you find and earn money to level up your skills, buy the machines, and unlock better tools to streamline your operations.

Process Trash: Process the junk to make it more valuable. Every bit counts!

Find Rare Items: Search the junk for valuable items like money or gold bars.

Restore & Renovate: Bring old, rusty items back to life—whether it’s an old car or dilapidated furniture, your skills can make them valuable again.

Master the Machines: Operate powerful tools and machinery, from tower cranes to scrap presses that can crush entire cars.

Try Your Luck: Spend your hard-earned cash on mystery containers and uncover the surprises hidden inside. Will you strike it rich or find nothing but junk?

Grab your work gloves, fire up the machines, and get ready to rake in the profits—because in this junkyard, one person’s trash is your ticket to wealth. Build your junk empire and become the king of scrap!
70010000128414.name: Junkyard Builder: King Of Scrap

70010000129162.description:
Deep in the Amazon, a lone treasure hunter in search of Ultimate Power gets more than he bargains for when he's turned to goo and falls deep into the bowels of an ancient temple. As the gooey treasure hunter, you start with nothing. No powers. No weapons. Not even the ability to jump. Only by exploring the temple can you begin to understand and unleash the powers of the slime.

Keep playing to unlock new powers, own your enemies, and hopefully uncover the secret to regaining your humanity.
70010000129162.intro: He came for ultimate power. He got it — sort of.
70010000129162.name: Gelatinous: Humanity Lost

70010000131663.description:
You've overslept, missing the first lecture of the day! Your class assignment is due, but what time were you supposed to meet your study group again? These are everyday little problems that require some problem-solving, minor sleuthing, and resolution!

Little Problems is a refreshing departure from the typical narrative of grandiose conflicts and complex villainy. It invites players to delve into a world where detective work is about connecting with friends, understanding the small yet significant issues of daily life, and finding joy in the simplicity of resolution. This game isn't about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one little problem at a time.

This charming title, challenges players to solve mysteries around minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, little problems.

Key Features: 
• Cute, hand-drawn art by an Indonesian illustrator, Melinda.
• Solve Life’s Little Problems: Help Mary through life’s little challenges, small in scale, big in charm.
• Handcrafted Puzzles: Each level is a unique scenario, lovingly designed to be clever, approachable and satisfying.
• 10 Distinct Cases: Each case presents a different scenario with its own set of puzzles and surprises.
• Helpful Hints When You Need Them: If you get stuck, you can see where mistakes are, keeping the challenge fun, not frustrating.
• Easy to Pick Up, Hard to Put Down: Simple mechanics that grow into playful twists and surprising solutions.
70010000131663.intro: Solve minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, little problems. This game is not about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one case at a time.
70010000131663.name: Little Problems: A Cozy Detective Game

70010000131877.description:
Welcome to Ironford, a cosy exploration game where adventure is all about discovery. Set in a quiet medieval fishing village along the coast, you'll wander through winding streets, wooden docks, market squares, forests, and hidden paths in search of every rare gem scattered throughout the world.

Features:
>Explore a handcrafted medieval seaside village.
>Search for and collect every rare gem.
>Wander through docks, markets, forests and village streets.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration and collecting.

Can you uncover every rare gem hidden within Ironford?
70010000131877.intro: Search a peaceful seaside village for every hidden gem.
70010000131877.name: Ironford

70010000134027.description:
Welcome to Horse Spirit Valley

Step into a soft, sunlit fantasy where the rhythm is simple: ride, sparkle, dress up your mount, and unlock new pastures when you are ready for the next view. No rush—just you, the trail, and a pocket full of dreams.

Ride and Explore

Travel on horseback across handcrafted 3D valleys filled with grass, sunlight, and open space.

Every journey has a clear goal: collect all the diamonds hidden throughout the world. Find them all to complete the area and enjoy the satisfaction of clearing every corner of the map.

Diamonds That Work for You

Diamonds collected during your adventures remain available between play sessions, with your current balance always visible.

Spend your savings on new environments or cosmetic items for your horse. When you do not have enough diamonds, the game clearly shows how many more you need.

Make the Horse Unmistakably Yours

Create a horse that feels completely your own with a wide range of customization options:

* Size
* Coat color
* Mane style and color
* Saddle and reins
* Armor style and color
* Horn shape and color

Preview every option in the customization hub, save your favorite appearance, and use collected diamonds to unlock premium styles.

Pastures Waiting Beyond the Horizon

The world selection screen displays each environment, its name, and its unlock price.

Your first pasture is available from the beginning. Additional dreamlike landscapes can be unlocked whenever you have collected enough diamonds and are ready for a new adventure.

Play Your Way

Adjust visual settings, real-time shadows, and music to create the experience that suits you best.

A varied soundtrack keeps menus and journeys feeling fresh, while a calm fairy-tale atmosphere follows you throughout the valley.

Comfortable Controls

Simple and intuitive controls make exploring, navigating menus, and customizing your horse easy and comfortable.

Pause the game, adjust settings, or return to the main menu whenever you need a break. Your progress will remain safely saved.

Who It Is For

Horse Spirit Valley is a low-stress, satisfying pocket of magic where you can explore, collect, customize, unlock, and repeat.

If gentle fantasy worlds, sparkling collectibles, and a beautiful unicorn-inspired mount sound like your perfect relaxing adventure, saddle up and enter the valley.
70010000134027.intro: Explore peaceful 3D valleys on horseback, collect diamonds, unlock new pastures, and customize your own unicorn.
70010000134027.name: Horse Spirit Valley

70010000134077.description:
Relax and enjoy the timeless fun of jigsaw puzzles with Frog Jigsaw Puzzle. Piece together a collection of beautifully illustrated frog-themed images featuring peaceful ponds, lush forests, and colorful nature scenes.

Whether you're a casual player or a dedicated puzzle fan, Frog Jigsaw Puzzle offers hours of satisfying gameplay.

Features:
>Beautiful frog-themed puzzle artwork
>Multiple levels
>Relaxing gameplay with no time limits
>Save your progress and continue anytime
>Suitable for players of all ages
70010000134077.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Frog

70010000134143.description:
Ride into the Valley

Horse Spirit Valley 2 is a peaceful open-world horse adventure. Gallop across rolling meadows, autumn woods, winter frost, lilac dusk and emerald night — five distinct worlds waiting for your next ride.

Befriend wild horses, collect sparkling gems, and build the stable of your dreams in the Horse Boutique. Soft exploration, beautiful nature, and the freedom to ride wherever the trail leads.
Explore Five Worlds

Every level has its own mood, light and terrain:

Meadow— sunlit hills, wildflowers and open trails
Autumn Forest— warm earth, birch trees and golden light
Winter Frost— snowy fields under a quiet sky
Lilac Dusk— soft evening colours and calm paths
Emerald Night— deep forest atmosphere after dark

Unlock new worlds in the shop, select your favourite, and ride straight into it.
Tame & Ride

Wild horses roam the valley. Approach gently, earn their trust, and welcome them into your stable. Switch mounts in the Horse Boutique — your friends are always waiting.
Horse Boutique

Make every horse your own:

Coats and spirit colours
Mane styles and mane colour
Saddles and reins
Horns and size option
Your collection of tamed horses

Try looks on a live preview, buy with gems, and save the style you love.

Collect, Discover, Relax
Gather gems across the valley
Follow the compass to points of interest
Capture beautiful moments with Photo Mode
70010000134143.intro: Ride free through a living valley of meadows, forests, frost and dusk. Tame wild horses, style them in the Horse Boutique, collect gems.
70010000134143.name: Horse Spirit Valley 2

70070000039501.description:
Create, decorate, and relax with a collection designed for players who love cozy spaces and creative freedom.
This bundle includes three complete games, each offering a unique way to transform ordinary places into warm, inviting environments. Design the perfect workspace, organize and decorate charming homes, and celebrate the holiday season by creating a beautifully decorated Christmas tree in magical festive settings.
Arrange furniture, place decorations, personalize every corner, and experiment with countless layouts at your own pace. Whether you're building a productive creative studio, unpacking and organizing a dream home, or filling the air with holiday spirit, every experience encourages creativity without pressure or time limits.
70070000039501.name: Cozy Unpacking Collection

70070000039740.description:
Take to the skies with a collection built for aviation enthusiasts, adrenaline seekers, and anyone who has ever dreamed of flying.

This bundle includes three complete flight experiences, each offering a unique perspective on the freedom of the open sky. Master realistic aircraft, sharpen your piloting skills through challenging flight missions, race against the clock across demanding aerial courses, and experience the unforgettable thrill of skydiving from breathtaking heights.

From precise takeoffs and smooth landings to high-speed checkpoint races and heart-pounding freefall, every adventure rewards skill, confidence, and determination. Unlock new aircraft, improve your abilities, customize your equipment, and explore diverse environments as you continue your journey through the world of aviation.
70070000039740.name: Flight Simulator 2026 Collection

70070000039741.description:
Step into a collection of psychological horror experiences where familiar places become endless nightmares and every path leads deeper into the unknown.

This bundle includes two horror adventures, each challenging you to escape vast, surreal environments that defy logic and reality. Explore flooded labyrinths shrouded in silence, wander through an abandoned parking garage where every level feels the same, solve unsettling puzzles, and search for a way out while an unseen presence follows your every move.

As you push forward, ordinary surroundings slowly twist into impossible spaces filled with tension, mystery, and constant uncertainty. Every corridor invites exploration, every decision carries risk, and every new discovery raises more questions than answers.
70070000039741.name: Escape Backrooms Collection

70070000039845.description:
Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Japanese gardens in Anime Waifu Simulator: Sakura Garden. Surrounded by blooming sakura trees, flowing streams, and tranquil ponds, craft your perfect retreat filled with elegance, peace, and charm. Decorate your space with traditional elements like bamboo, stone lanterns, and koi fish, while enjoying relaxing moments with your charming waifus.

This bundle includes the main title, the Girls Passion DLC, and the Sakura Coin Pack DLC, adding even more depth to your garden experience. Unlock new waifus with unique personalities, heartfelt stories, and stylish outfits, and use Sakura Coins to acquire exclusive decorations, rare items, and beautiful accessories. Enhance every corner of your garden, making it a truly magical and immersive sanctuary.

Relax, bond, and create a Japanese-inspired paradise where every detail reflects your vision of beauty and tranquility.
70070000039845.name: Anime Waifu Simulator GOLD EDITION

70070000039854.description:
Step into a nostalgic shopping experience with All-Star Supermarket Simulator: Vinyl Vibes, where retro charm meets smooth gameplay. Browse aisles filled with classic vinyl tunes, manage your store, and enjoy a unique atmosphere inspired by vintage style and iconic beats. Every moment becomes a musical journey as you build and customize your ultimate supermarket.

This bundle includes the main title, the Coin Flip DLC, and the Storage Pack DLC, giving you everything you need to enhance your experience. Get an instant coin boost to expand faster, upgrade your setup, and unlock new possibilities, while storage solutions let you organize and showcase your growing vinyl collection with flair. Create a supermarket that sounds as good as it looks.

Feel the rhythm, build your space, and turn every session into a groove-filled adventure.
70070000039854.intro: Build your store with style and sound!
70070000039854.name: All-Star Supermarket Simulator Gold Edition

70010000114678.description:
Speed across anti-gravity tracks filled with jumps, shortcuts, hazards, and explosive pickups on your way to victory! Get revved up for local multiplayer, challenging Event Races, a powerful Course Editor, and more.

Create your own tracks, discover new community creations, master every shortcut, and leave your rivals behind. Whether you're chasing the perfect lap or battling for first place, there's always another race waiting in Star Racer.
70010000114678.intro: Race through futuristic cities where gravity is just another obstacle!
70010000114678.name: Star Racer

70010000117553.description:
Tales of Formentera is an adventure game set on a small island inspired by the real landscapes of Formentera, where old legends shape its history. Something mysterious is happening, and the people of the island need your help to uncover the truth.

Explore the island freely, visit its most iconic locations, and talk to the locals to learn about their stories, traditions, and legends. You will piece together clues that help you understand what is really going on. 

Throughout your journey, you will discover hidden places, solve puzzles, collect unique items, and help islanders with optional side quests. Tales of Formentera invites you to explore at your own pace and uncover the secrets of an island full of history, mystery, and charm.


Features:
* Adventure game focused on exploration and discovery
* An open island inspired by the real locations of Formentera
* Interact with islanders and learn about their stories and legends
* Puzzles integrated into the environment
* Optional side quests where you help the locals
* Collectibles hidden throughout the island
70010000117553.intro: Explore the island of Formentera and uncover its stories and ancient legends
70010000117553.name: Tales of Formentera

70010000126844.description:
A simple paper airplane becomes the start of a quiet and meaningful journey.

Lifted by the wind, you guide a fragile creation across a world that feels alive, changing with every new area you reach. What begins as an easy glide slowly turns into a path that asks for attention, control, and a sense of direction.

Movement is smooth and natural, built around momentum and balance. You rise, fall, and adjust your angle to stay in the air, learning how to use the wind instead of fighting against it. Invisible currents carry you forward, while obstacles and narrow passages test your ability to react and stay focused.

Each environment tells its own story through space and atmosphere. Open, warm areas give you freedom to explore and understand the flow of flight, while more complex zones introduce tighter paths, shifting air, and moments where precision becomes essential. The pace evolves naturally, allowing you to grow more confident without breaking the calm rhythm of the experience.

As you progress, your journey becomes longer and more controlled. You begin to reach places that once felt distant, adapting your movement and improving your ability to stay airborne. Every section feels like a step forward — not just in distance, but in understanding how to move with intention.

This is not about speed or competition. It’s about flow, direction, and the feeling of carrying something forward through space and time. A quiet experience where every movement matters, and every flight brings you closer to where you’re meant to arrive.
70010000126844.intro: A small flight. A big journey.
70010000126844.name: Paper Airplane Flying Game

70010000132427.description:
Komorebi is a fully voice acted story taking place in a dystopian 2041. Set against the backdrop of social revolt, you move to Toronto to start a brand new chapter in your life. Make friends, party, and form bonds and romances that will last a lifetime! While pages turn in your life however, they also turn in the world. As your morals clash with those in power, you and your group may walk an irreversible path in the name of equality and a brighter future.

Enjoy your new life...

FEATURES
- A lengthy story, several full novels in length.
- Approx. 18,000 lines over 150,000 words of dialogue.
- Over 10 hours of voiceover audio delivered by an incredible cast.
- Romance a varied cast of characters with no limitations or restrictions. Romance one, or all.
- Experience the story in your own unique way, through the Fragment Map system.
- Gain more insight into the world through diary entries and counselor sessions.
70010000132427.intro: In a society plagued by visions of the future, a group of friends attempt to find their own way in a predestined life. A fully voice acted dystopian furry visual novel/dating-sim.
70010000132427.name: Komorebi - A Furry Visual Novel

70010000132499.description:
Order Automatica is a tactical roguelite autobattler where every move shapes the outcome.

Build your army by placing demons onto a 3×3 ritual board, discover powerful synergies, and adapt your strategy to survive increasingly dangerous encounters. Positioning, timing, and smart combinations are the keys to victory.

Every run offers new units, relics, and upgrades, allowing you to create wildly different builds - from relentless summoners to unstoppable frontline warriors or devastating spellcasters.

Master challenging boss battles, unlock new content, and experiment with endless tactical possibilities as you uncover the secrets hidden within the ritual.

Features:
• Tactical roguelite autobattler gameplay
• Unique 3×3 ritual board with deep positioning mechanics
• Dozens of demons, relics, and powerful combinations
• Procedurally generated runs with high replayability
• Challenging bosses that demand new strategies every run
• Fast-paced sessions with meaningful tactical decisions
70010000132499.intro: A small board. Endless possibilities. Like chess with demons.
70010000132499.name: Order Automatica

70010000132580.description:
This pack includes the games: Speedway Racing and Grand Prix Rock ´N Racing.

In Speedway Racing, you will enjoy the fastest, most spectacular races at over 350 Km/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 12 rivals.
There are several modes available, including Championship, Arcade and 4-player multiplayer.

Grand Prix Rock 'N Racing gives you the fastest, most exciting races. You can evolve your car, improving the engine, brakes, tires and more until you've achieved the perfect evolution to win the Championship!

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Races with 12 opponents.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.
70010000132580.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000132580.name: Speedy Bundle Speedway & Grand Prix

70010000133001.description:
Deep within an ancient forest lies the legend of KUPAR—a mysterious statue said to hold the power to break a centuries-old curse. Most believe it's nothing more than folklore.

To lift the curse, you'll need to uncover forgotten secrets, solve mysterious puzzles, and survive the horrors hidden within the forest. But one question remains...

Does the KUPAR statue truly exist?

Features:
>Explore a mysterious cursed forest filled with secrets.
>Search for the legendary KUPAR statue.
>Solve puzzles to break the curse.
>Experience atmospheric first-person horror and exploration.
70010000133001.intro: Some legends should never be disturbed.
70010000133001.name: KUPAR: Horror Mystery

70010000133532.description:
Play as a frog and take on a colourful parkour obstacle course filled with moving platforms, powerful jump pads, dangerous traps, and tricky jumps. Reach the end of each level and prove your parkour skills.

Looking for a tougher challenge? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One mistake sends you all the way back.

Features
>Complete challenging parkour levels.
>Jump across moving platforms and use jump pads.
>Avoid traps and dangerous obstacles.
>Attempt Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.
70010000133532.intro: Hop, jump, and dodge your way through every level!
70010000133532.name: Frog Parkour Obby

70010000069054.description:
After the brief peace that followed the wars of the portals that devastated the country, new winds of war threaten its inhabitants when the new king of Imperia together with the Sacred Kingdom have started a war against non-humans, using the services of one of the Last Wizards of Arborea: Trece XIII and their generals, it is the moment of the prophecy, a chosen one will unite Men and beasts to bring peace. Welcome to the world of Arborea, welcome to Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster.

— You are the last of the Beastmaster, use the souls of animals/creatures to transform and progress in the adventure.

— A continuous Metroidvania-style map, open new paths or unlock new routes with your Beastmaster abilities, evil and sorcery lurks in all corners.

— Gather beads for your ritual necklace: you will get fangs, amulets, and plant roots that will change your attacks, vitality, or Mana.

— Enter into a duel in the different Arenas the battle will be with a close camera and energy bars like in the classic fighting games. In the Arena you can enhance your skills and get unique items.

— Find new sword techniques that your old Sensei taught you, use magic potions or summons curses. Thanks to your sword, you can get the power of a god.

— Throughout your adventure you will find many NPCs (Non-Playing Characters) that will give more strength to the narrative of the story, dealing with them will open the possibility of knowing new missions, arcs (as in an Anime series) and complete different endings.
70010000069054.intro: Use your heart-devouring sword to unleash your inner beast and end the threat to Arborea in this hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania.
70010000069054.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster

70010000054202.description:
Join KUBO in a new adventure that will take you to the four corners of the world in search of the sacred crystals to free the inhabitants kidnapped by the infamous Moglar!

Journey through the underworld, the graveyard, the underwater world, and the skies. Collect the items — there will be many monsters and bosses on your way before the final battle in your enemy's castle!

- Explore four unique worlds: the underworld, the graveyard, the underwater realm, and the skies
- Battle monsters and bosses on the road to Moglar's castle
- Also includes KUBO and KUBO 2
70010000054202.intro: Four worlds. One hero. And the two adventures that started it all.
70010000054202.name: KUBO 3

70010000124000.description:
The job is simple: destroy evidence. Leave no trace. Don’t die in the process. 
Hazard Pay is a pixel-art block-pushing puzzler set in a crumbling dystopian world. You’ll navigate alone through abandoned and contaminated facilities, dodging environmental hazards while completing your employer’s checklist with calculated efficiency.
Pack up the truck and head to the site. Mop the floors. Remove the evidence. Destroy the ███████. Do not leave anything behind, not even your footsteps. There’s blood on the floor and smoke in the air. Relax. It’s just another accident to clean up. Do the job properly and no one has to get in trouble. 
Each site is a compact, intricate puzzle with moving parts. You can use the environment to gather scattered documents or push ███████ into chemical barrels to erase any wrongdoing. One wrong move, and you could be trapped, dissolved in acid, or worse. Plan ahead. Improvise when you must. Stay sharp. Global Leaderboards.
Even after a job’s done, you can always go back. Every move is tracked, and your final step count determines your rank. Pull off a perfect run, and your name might just show up on the global leaderboard. Compare your stats with friends or the world. Just remember, your employer is always watching.
All you know is the name: IPT. No faces, no meetings. Just a radio, and they talk first. You can feel something’s off. But are you really ready to dig into it? Some things are better left buried. Will you stay obedient… or resist? Features Ingenious, compact, handcrafted puzzle levels. Grid-based push/pull mechanics with environmental twists. Global and friends leaderboards. Dystopian narrative told through the environment. Detailed pixel art and matching atmosphere.
70010000124000.name: Hazard Pay

70010000132398.description:
Circuit Flow is a wire-routing puzzle game set on a compact circuit board. Draw traces to connect colored signals from the board edge to their matching components - LEDs, speakers, fans, and displays all need the right current to power up.

Start simple with single-color routes, then tackle resistors that transform signal colors, splitters that break secondaries into primaries, and mixers that combine them into new ones. Plan your paths carefully - wires can't overlap, and a wrong turn means a short circuit.

Features:
- Hand-crafted puzzle levels with progressive difficulty
- Color mixing and splitting mechanics
- Circuit designer - build and share your own levels
- Arcade mode with procedurally generated boards
- Encyclopedia of real electronic components
- Clean, readable circuit board visual style
70010000132398.intro: Route the signal. Power the board.
70010000132398.name: Circuit Flow

70010000132733.description:
An old factory district has stood silent for decades after a series of unexplained disappearances forced everyone to leave. Locals say the entire area is cursed, bound by ancient voodoo relics hidden throughout the abandoned buildings.

Determined to end the nightmare, you enter the district with one goal: find every cursed relic and break the curse once and for all. But as you search through abandoned factories, rusting warehouses, dark alleyways, and forgotten offices, you realize something else still calls this place home..

Features:
>Explore a large abandoned factory district.
>Search for cursed voodoo relics to break the curse.
>Evade a GIANT creature that relentlessly stalks the shadows.
>Experience immersive first-person horror with atmospheric environments.
70010000132733.name: Cursed District: Horror

70010000133561.description:
Play as a frog and jump through a space-themed obstacle course filled with floating platforms, jump pads, moving obstacles, and dangerous traps. Complete every level while avoiding the endless void below.

For the ultimate challenge, try Hardcore Mode. All checkpoints are disabled, so one mistake sends you back to the beginning.

Features:
>Play as a frog in outer space.
>Complete challenging parkour levels.
>Leap across floating and moving platforms.
>Avoid traps, obstacles, and the endless void.
>Attempt Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.
70010000133561.intro: One small hop for a frog, one giant leap through space!
70010000133561.name: Space Parkour Obby

70010000061752.description: A service industry apocalypse Welcome to Roman Sands RE:Build, a shape-shifting absurdist adventure that twists two stories together, taking you from a luxury tropical resort to post-apocalyptic survival. Two stories of escape The Resort Wash up on the beach of an indulgent Resort. According to the guests, you work here—AND you're slacking off. Race against time to rank up and earn equipment to stem their never-ending tide of demands. The only catch to your employment: the sun is days away from swallowing the world, and the guests couldn't care less. Look under the surface: uncover the resort's secrets and solve puzzles in an attempt to escape. Cling to life after the end The Facility One of the last people left alive, you are the caretaker of a decaying zoological research station. Your only companions are a dead cow and a voice on the radio; it sounds familiar, but ... from where? A parasite clogs the guts of your station: will you exterminate it and preserve the station's work, even at the cost of your own survival? Manic genre mashup Are these worlds the same? When are they? WHAT are they!? Two distinct narratives overlap and mutate in a delirious genre apocalypse: adventure, visual novel, puzzle solving, survival simulation, and atmospheric horror collide to tell a story of escaping the inescapable.
70010000061752.intro: A service industry adventure with an apocalyptic flavor. A manic genre mashup told across two broken realities. Step through the cracks: find your Exit.
70010000061752.name: Roman Sands RE:Build

70010000100310.description:
Dive into the story of Nanoca Flanka's revitalization of Tristia! 

The beautiful city of Tristia, nicknamed the "Jewel of the Sea," once bustled with maritime trade until recent dragon attacks stripped the city of its charm, and the people have resigned to its state of decay.

Tristia: Legacy is a city building simulation game where you play as crafter-inventor Nanoca Flanka, who has been challenged to restore the city within a year. Research and create new items for vendors, fulfill invention requests and build new facilities to help revitalize the city's economy. Enjoy a passionate story that unfolds based on your actions on your journey to bring back Tristia's luster.
70010000100310.name: Tristia: Legacy

70010000100727.description:
Nanoca Flanka's battle to revitalize the floundering city of Tristia begins! 

The beautiful city of Tristia, nicknamed the "Jewel of the Sea," once bustled with maritime trade until recent dragon attacks stripped the city of its charm, and the people have resigned to its state of decay.

Tristia: Restore takes place alongside the story of Tristia: Legacy, but focuses on the day-to-day running of Nanoca’s shop. She has some major crafting projects to complete, but while she works to finish them, a constant barrage of requests pour in. Quickness counts as you gather materials, choose the right equipment, and deliver the necessary items for each level. Can you accomplish everything before time runs out?
70010000100727.name: Tristia: Restore

70010000101704.description:
Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River is a classic-style graphic adventure about a person adrift in space who is rescued by a luxurious space station orbiting Mars. Playing as River, you'll immerse yourself in a world of comfort and pleasure—until you realize the station hides a dark secret.

In Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River, you'll navigate the station's lavish leisure facilities, using your wits to solve puzzles and move forward. As the story unfolds, you’ll begin to uncover the sinister side of the station and must choose whether to ignore it or take action.

The choices you make in Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River will challenge your ethics and test your morality. Will you do whatever it takes to protect yourself and survive, or risk everything to expose the truth and stop what's happening on board?

The game's pixel art style creates a stunning, immersive world that captures the spirit of classic adventure games. From the luxurious amenities to the station’s shadowy corners, every location in Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River is full of character and ready to be explored. Its gripping story will keep you on the edge of your seat. With multiple endings to discover, this is a game you'll want to replay.

Are you ready to embark on a journey of self-discovery and uncover the dark secrets of the space station orbiting Mars?
70010000101704.intro: Uncover the dark truth behind a luxury space station orbiting Mars.
70010000101704.name: Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River

70010000105771.description:
A time-traveling RPG adventure from Masato Kato, creator of countless classic RPGs
Product Summary
Aldo embarks on an adventure beyond time and space to save his sister, Feinne, from the clutches of the beastfolk.

A richly woven tale by scenario writer and director, Masato Kato, unfolds across the ages, alongside a main theme composed by Yasunori Mitsuda, music incorporating traditional folk instruments and an orchestra by Procyon Studios, and a stellar voice cast.

The strategic command battles, which feature exhilarating actions like chain skills that trigger successive strikes, and Another Force that allows a barrage of attacks, can be fought with original parties composed from a total of 19 characters.

After clearing the main story, New Game+ offers a new adventure filled with new faces and over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆Strategic Command Battles
The lands of Another Eden are rife with monsters—run into them to initiate a command-based battle and take them down.
Create your own original parties, unleash chain skills, and create chains to trigger successive strikes!
Unleash a flurry of attacks with Another Force to beat your enemy into submission!

◆Befriend and Forge Meaningful Bonds with 18 Allies
18 allies of different races and eras await Aldo on his journey.
Allies' stories are told through various quests. Encounter quests depict their first meeting with Aldo, character quests reveal their past and purpose, and kinship quests explore their relationship with Aldo.

◆Embark on a New Adventure with New Game+
Complete the main story to unlock New Game+ and embark on a new adventure with your allies as they are!
New Game+ also introduces a brand-new character, Ramiu, and features over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆New Features to Enrich Your Time-Traveling Adventure
Enrich your adventure beyond time and space by logging the feline friends you encounter in the cat catalog, and creating weapons, armor, and food from different eras with the crafting feature.
70010000105771.intro: Now begins an RPG beyond time and space
70010000105771.name: Another Eden Begins

70010000107511.description:
In Mr. Sleepy Man, you play as a sleepy guy who's up way past his bedtime and out of control!

The citizens of Bedtime Town don’t stand a chance! Make a mess of everything you find and turn the entire town against you!
Mr. Sleepy Man features a fully expressive 3D platformer moveset. Jump, glide, and dive your way through interconnected levels that encourage exploration and experimentation.

Interactivity is key! You can pick up and play with every item you find. You’ll need to use the environment to your advantage if you want to create chaos and find every secret this game has to offer!
Your actions will have consequences! NPCs will remember how you've treated them. Friendly faces won't last long when you're up to no good, so be wise! 

Bedtime Town's cast of outrageous characters have their own independent logic. These aren't copy + paste NPCs. Each one of these characters responds in a different way that reflects their own personality!
Mr. Sleepy Man features an interconnected world filled with secrets for the player to explore. With over 250 objectives to complete (including collectables), you'll easily get lost finding every nook and cranny this game has to offer.
With a fully original soundtrack composed and performed by the developer, Mr. Sleepy Man delivers a soundscape that blends nostalgic homages to classic 3D platformers with the raw, melodic edge of early 2000s alternative rock.

List of features:
- A one-of-a-kind soundtrack written and performed by the developer. 
- Over 350 objectives to complete! (Including collectables)
- Chaos simulator gameplay!
- Immersive environments, unhinged characters, and interactive NPCs.
- Fluid character movement!
- SLEEP BUTTON! Go to sleep at any time!
70010000107511.intro: Mr. Sleepy Man is up way past his bedtime and out of control! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!
70010000107511.name: Mr. Sleepy Man

70010000107710.description:
Condo is a quiet, short, and atmospheric first-person exploration game. You wander through an apartment complex at night, meet its residents, and uncover hidden stories.

Playtime: ≈ 30 minutes. 
Finding all events unlocks an ending. 
No rush. No destination. ♥
70010000107710.intro: Unable to sleep, you navigate a quiet condo complex. There's no rush - just you, the building, its inhabitants, and the stories they hold.
70010000107710.name: Condo

70010000110143.description:
Maestro is an easy-to-learn hard-to-master rhythm game that turns you into an orchestra conductor. With precise Joy-Con™ motion controls, every gesture matters. You don’t just play the music: you conduct it.

Explore a curated repertoire spanning movies and gaming soundtracks, classical and jazz music bringing together the most iconic works in music History. Conduct scores from Star Wars, Game of Thrones, The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, and Attack on Titan and the timeless masterpieces of Beethoven, Mozart, Wagner, Vivaldi, and Duke Ellington.

Step into the Parisian artistic society and discover music, culture and gastronomy where real orchestra conducting meets griping rhythm gameplay. Set the tempo, cue the instruments, guide the crescendos, and lead every performance in real time.

Are you ready to become a true Maestro?
70010000110143.intro: Grab your Joy-Con™ and throw real Maestro moves!
70010000110143.name: Maestro

70010000113820.description:
Time To Usher In a Life As Ellie the Little Apprentice Witch!
• Step into the shoes of Ellie, an apprentice witch dispatched from Lucerine Ortu—a land of witches—and experience her journey of self development!
• Explore brand-new areas, craft potions and help the villagers. A heartwarming and cozy adventure awaits you here.
• Fish, gather, decorate your house, and interact with cats! We have all kinds of activities that will make every day an unforgettable experience.

Activities and Explorations as a Witch
• Navigate forests, caves, cliffs and lakes on your broom to meet adorable life forms and complete your Encyclopedia.
• Gather materials to craft problem-solving potions, discover hidden treasures and unlock new paths.

Stories of the Village and Its Inhabitants
• Work as an apprentice witch. Help out at the village and solve problems for the villagers.
• Make friends with the villagers as you restore the village. By establishing bonds, you can unlock their stories and even learn about their secrets.

Collections and Home Decoration
• Gather recipes and materials to craft furniture, which will give your living space a personal touch.
• Collect and customize brooms to add extra enjoyment to your explorations.

Laid-back Moments
• Spend your peaceful free time fishing and chatting. Interact with cats to deepen your cross-species friendships.
• Create your exclusive story in this magical yet ever so relatable world!
70010000113820.intro: Begin a cozy apprentice witch life in the woods with Ellie.
70010000113820.name: Little Witch in the Woods

70010000120177.description:
After quelling the coup d'état that shook the Kingdom of Liberl, Estelle and Joshua have finally become senior bracers. However, on the eve of the Queen's Birthday Festival, Joshua reveals the dark truth of his past before vanishing into the night, leaving only his brief farewell: "Goodbye, Estelle." Armed with Joshua's harmonica and an unshakable determination, Estelle embarks upon a continent-spanning quest to find her partner.

During her journey, she must take on the sinister society of Ouroboros as it emerges from the shadows to plunge Liberl into utter chaos. The capital in flames. A colossal airship darkens the skies. The looming threat of the Shining Ring... Confronted with the greatest crisis in the history of Liberl, Estelle and her allies battle to find Joshua and untangle the web of intrigue and conspiracy woven by Ouroboros!

Key Features

■ CONTINUE YOUR 1ST CHAPTER JOURNEY
By carrying over your clear data from 1st Chapter, you can obtain exciting bonus items that will let you progress through the story more smoothly.

■ MORE COMBAT OPTIONS THAN EVER BEFORE
Overpower your enemies with new Crafts and S-Crafts! Link your characters' attacks during Quick Battles with the new Brave Rush, and make full use of the orbment system for access to Arts.

■ AN UNFORGETTABLE STORY
Dive into an intricately woven narrative to uncover the conspiracies threatening the Kingdom of Liberl.

■ EXPANSIVE SIDE CONTENT
Enjoy a variety of new content in the sequel, including minigames like fishing and poker, cooking with your companions, and fan-favorite characters joining as playable party members.

Experience the expansive combat system, richly realized world, and stirring story of the 2nd chapter of the Trails series!
70010000120177.intro: Take Fate Into Your Own Hands
70010000120177.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter

70010000121596.description:
Woodo is a cozy diorama puzzle game where you assemble wooden scenes piece by piece. As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene slowly fills with color and comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises. Follow the story of Foxy and Ben the frog through a series of interconnected dioramas, each capturing a unique moment from their shared adventure.

Tactile Satisfaction
Feel like you’re assembling a real toy, with each piece clicking into place with a satisfying, tactile sensation, as if it’s right in your hands.
Assembling objects isn’t linear—you have to turn and explore the 3D space to reveal hidden pieces. Watch as each piece transforms the world around you, with playful animations that react to your placements, bringing the diorama to life.

A Warm Companion
With a friendly narrator's voice, immerse yourself in a world when time was plentiful and much of it was spent outdoors, when the simplest things surprised and when every day promised great adventure. Feelings that were more present in childhood and are often missed or even forgotten with time passing.

Feed Your Inner Child
The game features funny and charming characters that create an atmosphere of carefree joy and humor, reminding you that happiness is what your inner child needs.

-Assemble beautiful dioramas piece by piece with a unique puzzle mechanic
-The game adapts to your pace, providing assistance when you need it
-Gameplay changes to adapt the narration
-Simple but deeply meaningful story
-The comforting voice of the narrator keeps you company
-Get carried away by nostalgic feelings of when things were simple
-Plenty of funny characters and silly animations make you smile
70010000121596.intro: Woodo feels like a 3D coloring book you can touch, a relaxing tale told through handcrafted wooden dioramas.
70010000121596.name: Woodo

70010000122900.description:
Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren't always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method.

Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM…

Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA!

Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done? 
Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened.
It did. It was Dan!

Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt and Photo Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook.

Funny, colourful and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast and moving on to the next job.

Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy.
70010000122900.intro: A ridiculous, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist.
70010000122900.name: Sniper Dan

70010000128024.description:
Classic literature meets classic gaming in Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure! This 2D platformer stars Jane Austen herself, the beloved English novelist, who finds herself transported into an 8-bit video game.

Explore 8-bit England, battle characters ripped straight from Austen's novels, and defeat enemies the only way a proper author knows how — with a quill. Collect the scattered pages and restore Miss Austen's books to the 8-bit library before it's too late!

- Battle characters from Jane Austen's novels
- Explore 8-bit England
- Defeat enemies with a quill
- Restore Miss Austen's books to the 8-bit library
70010000128024.intro: She wrote the rules. Now she's breaking them — with a quill.
70010000128024.name: Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure

70010000128637.description:
A time-traveling RPG adventure from Masato Kato, creator of countless classic RPGs
Product Summary
Aldo embarks on an adventure beyond time and space to save his sister, Feinne, from the clutches of the beastfolk.

A richly woven tale by scenario writer and director, Masato Kato, unfolds across the ages, alongside a main theme composed by Yasunori Mitsuda, music incorporating traditional folk instruments and an orchestra by Procyon Studios, and a stellar voice cast.

The strategic command battles, which feature exhilarating actions like chain skills that trigger successive strikes, and Another Force that allows a barrage of attacks, can be fought with original parties composed from a total of 19 characters.

After clearing the main story, New Game+ offers a new adventure filled with new faces and over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆Strategic Command Battles
The lands of Another Eden are rife with monsters—run into them to initiate a command-based battle and take them down.
Create your own original parties, unleash chain skills, and create chains to trigger successive strikes!
Unleash a flurry of attacks with Another Force to beat your enemy into submission!

◆Befriend and Forge Meaningful Bonds with 18 Allies
18 allies of different races and eras await Aldo on his journey.
Allies' stories are told through various quests. Encounter quests depict their first meeting with Aldo, character quests reveal their past and purpose, and kinship quests explore their relationship with Aldo.

◆Embark on a New Adventure with New Game+
Complete the main story to unlock New Game+ and embark on a new adventure with your allies as they are!
New Game+ also introduces a brand-new character, Ramiu, and features over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆New Features to Enrich Your Time-Traveling Adventure
Enrich your adventure beyond time and space by logging the feline friends you encounter in the cat catalog, and creating weapons, armor, and food from different eras with the crafting feature.
70010000128637.intro: Now begins an RPG beyond time and space
70010000128637.name: Another Eden Begins Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000133431.description:
Shape Wars is a fast-paced local multiplayer strategy game where geometric armies clash for dominance. Build your base, spawn units, upgrade your forces, and deploy devastating EMPs or pilot a Commander to turn the tide of battle.

Play solo against cunning AI opponents or go head-to-head with up to 4 players in Free For All, Teams, or AI Teams mode. Capture resource points, upgrade damage and shields, and outmaneuver your rivals to be the last shape standing.

Features:
- 1-4 player local multiplayer
- 3 game modes: Free For All, Teams, AI Teams
- 4 unique maps with different resource layouts
- Build barracks, archery ranges, tank factories, and more
- Deploy EMPs to wipe enemy waves
- Pilot a Commander unit with rocket attacks and self-destruct EMP
- Capture resource points for income advantage
- Upgrade damage, shields, and building production
- Procedural sound effects and a neon glow aesthetic
- Quick matches - games last 3-10 minutes
70010000133431.name: Shape Wars

70010000134082.description:
Discover a fresh twist on classic jigsaw puzzles in Jigsaw Puzzle Fun Shapes! Complete 30 colorful and entertaining levels featuring unique puzzle pieces in all kinds of fun and creative shapes.

Each puzzle offers a charming illustration and a new challenge, making every level feel different. With cute artwork, vibrant colors, and relaxing gameplay, it's a delightful experience for players of all ages.

Features:
>30 puzzle levels
>Colorful, cute artwork
>Relaxing gameplay with no time limits
>Suitable for players of all ages
>Easy to pick up and play
70010000134082.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Fun Shapes

70050000074361.description: Includes the newly illustrated characters “Zeneth” and “Najaran” that can be used as avatars, as well as two Book(deck) covers, “Four Gods” and “Culdra (1st),” that can be used in-game.
70050000074361.name: Early Purchase Bonus

70050000075599.description: Use this pass to upgrade the game from the Nintendo Switch™ version to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.
70050000075599.name: Another Eden Begins Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000078308.description: You will receive with pre-order a limited-edition exclusive Baton! Stand out on the podium with a unique cosmetic item available only to early conductors.
70050000078308.name: Pre order bonus

70070000029705.description:
Revitalize Tristia in this updated collection!

The beautiful city of Tristia, nicknamed the "Jewel of the Sea," once bustled with maritime trade until recent dragon attacks stripped the city of its charm, and the people have resigned to its state of decay.

Play as Nanoca Flanka, and revitalize the city—your way.

Build and manage a thriving city in Legacy, where you'll research and create new items for vendors, fulfill invention requests and build new facilities to help revitalize the city's economy. Enjoy a passionate story that unfolds based on your actions on your journey to bring back Tristia's luster.

Or dive into an action-packed adventure in Restore, which focuses on the day-to-day running of the shop. Complete major crafting projects as a constant barrage of requests pour in. Quickness counts as you gather materials, choose the right equipment, and deliver the necessary items for each level. Can you accomplish everything before time runs out?
70070000029705.name: Tristia: Chronicles

70010000093293.description:
Every Who down in Who-ville is jingling, singing and celebrating. And guess who can’t wait to join them… the Grinch! Now, with a heart three sizes bigger, and a wish to show the Whos he’s changed, could the Grinch’s prize-winning tree be the perfect way to prove it?  

Play as the Grinch and Jumbo-Jump through snowy 3D worlds, collecting ornaments to make your tree sparkle brighter with every step. Overcome platforming challenges, explore every nook and cranny, and use the clever gadgets you find to get through each level. Unleash the Snowball Maker to freeze mischievous adversaries, launch into action with the Rocket Skates, and reach new heights with the Jetpack.  

Each level is filled with festive adventures. Hop through the Grinch’s Cave, dodging falling stalactites and zipping down watery chutes. Conquer Mt. Crumpit’s slippery ice and giant rolling snowballs. Find your way through Who-wood’s towering trees and springy mushrooms. Then explore Who-ville, leaping across hovering platforms and sneaking into the Whos’ cozy homes. Use your candy canes to break objects and release dazzling ornaments to decorate the Grinch’s Christmas tree and Who-ville Square. 

Adventure solo or team up in local co-op mode. Together with Max, you’ll have fun outsmarting pesky mice, wild forest bats and other curious creatures. Uncover hidden paths and collect every sparkly decoration you can find to make your tree shine.   

Make it a merry day in Who-ville, spread Christmas cheer, and create the most spectacular tree the Whos have ever seen! 

BRING CHEER TO THE WHOS: 
Embark on a festive journey to craft the most spectacular Christmas tree and decorate Who-ville Square. 

EXPLORE VIBRANT WORLDS: 
Swing, smash and Jumbo-Jump your way through the Grinch’s Cave, Mt. Crumpit, Who-wood and merry Who-ville. 

UNLEASH GRINCHY GADGETS: 
Take on every challenge with the help of the Rocket Skates, the Jetpack, the Snowball Maker, and more… 

CO-OP TO SAVE CHRISTMAS: 
Play solo as the Grinch, or team up with a friend as Max to help you. 

AN ADVENTURE FOR EVERYONE: 
Embark on a whimsical journey inspired by the original books, offering intuitive mechanics and challenges accessible to all.
70010000093293.intro: Play as the Grinch, collect ornaments, master gadgets, and tackle festive challenges to decorate the ultimate Christmas tree for the Whos.
70010000093293.name: The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas

70010000094509.description:
ROARR! Sounds like trouble… Did that come from Dino Island? Mayor Humdinger is causing chaos, making the dinosaurs scared and run away. 

Leap into colossal rescue missions with Chase, Marshall, Rubble, Skye, Rocky, and Zuma. Explore the Dino Plains and care for dinos at the Paleo Center. Drive across the shores and jungle to discover collectibles.  

Create roar-some new looks for your pup, vehicle, and dinosaurs. Play fun minigames in solo or in two-player mode.  

Can you stop the chaos before the volcano erupts? No dino’s too big, no pup’s too small in this prehistoric adventure! 

BE STRONG, BRAVE AND ROAR: Have Rex and Timmy by your side as you play with Chase, Marshall, Rubble, Skye, Rocky, and Zuma.  

RESCUE DINOS: Help lost dinosaurs find their way back to their families and care for them at the Paleo Center. 

FOSSIL-FILLED ACTION: Activate your pup’s unique skills anytime to overcome obstacles and stop Humdinger’s chaos. 

STOMP AROUND IN STYLE: Uncover accessories, skins and decorations to upgrade your pup and dino’s look.  

EXPLORE THE WILDS: Discover the Dino Plains, shores with secret pools, jungle filled with tropical fruit, and crystal caves in the volcano.
70010000094509.intro: Join the PAW Patrol and Rex on colossal missions across Dino Island. Create roar-some looks, play minigames with friends and more.
70010000094509.name: PAW Patrol™: Dino World

70010000098052.description:
Flamecraft is a cozy, turn-based strategy board game for 1 to 5 players. Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft. Gather and manage resources, enhance the shops by casting enchantments, and become the Master of Flamecraft.

Enter a cozy, vibrant world inhabited by dragons

Flamecraft is set in a fantasy world, in which dragons and magic are part of the ordinary. Here, you’ll meet the adorable artisan dragons, who will use their extraordinary flamecraft to help the town’s shopkeepers with their seemingly mundane tasks. 
The sweets are just waiting to be baked in Guilty Treasures, and Scale Mail Post is ready to send enchanted letters all across the town!

Master the art of resource management and create powerful combos to increase your reputation

You’ll have to strategize and outsmart other Flamekeepers if you want to come out on top. There are countless ways to victory, and it’s up to you to make the most of your skills. Your main task is to thoughtfully place dragon artisans in the town’s bustling shopping district. They will help you gather various resources from the shops, which you can later use to cast enchantments, triggering powerful ability combos. You’ll also befriend the extraordinary Fancy Dragons, with abilities allowing you to boost your reputation.
This, along with the Companion cards, which offer powerful additional scoring opportunities, will let you get the reputation points needed to win the game.

Play in a variety of gameplay modes, both single and multiplayer 

Whether you prefer playing solo, with friends, or people from around the world, Flamecraft has something in store for you. Test your skills against AI of varying difficulty or set up a relaxing custom game for your family to enjoy together.

Meet over 70 beautiful animated dragons and visit 30 unique shops while listening to a whimsical score

In Flamecraft, we’ve brought the enchanting world created by Sandara Tang to life. The beautifully illustrated dragons come to life as they use their craft in the vibrant, hand-painted town, full of animated 3D shops, booths, and laboratories. 
Paweł Górniak, the composer behind Wingspan and Quilts and Cats of Calico, is also back, with another spellbinding score.

Will you be able to claim the Master of Flamecraft title with the help of your creative little crafter friends?
70010000098052.intro: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic.
70010000098052.name: Flamecraft

70010000111686.description:
AU REVOIR - 2071

In a future where immortality is a privilege of the wealthy, Au Revoir Ltd. dominates the market with synthetic brains capable of storing human consciousness. Sentinels are tasked with locating these minds and carrying out the recovery and transfer process into new bodies.

Explore interactive environments, collect documents and clues, solve unique puzzles, and make decisions that influence the course of the story. Use your car to navigate different areas and interact with characters who hide more than they reveal.

ENGAGING NARRATIVE

Experience a rich and complex story where the narrative unfolds with depth, filled with twists and moral dilemmas that challenge your view of the world and of the protagonist.

IMMERSIVE SETTING

Explore a carefully crafted futuristic world with detailed environments and striking visual design. The neon-noir atmosphere blends vibrant colors with a dense mood, creating a deeply immersive cyberpunk setting.

DEEP CHARACTERS

Interact with a variety of characters, each with their own personality, motivations, and hidden secrets. Conversations reveal crucial details and open up different paths, adding weight to every encounter and multiple ways to interpret what’s truly happening.

INVESTIGATIVE CHALLENGES

Face puzzles that require logic, observation, and attention to detail. Gather clues, connect information, and solve narrative-driven challenges. Each solved mystery brings you closer to the truth — or to new questions to uncover.

Prepare for an unforgettable journey in Au Revoir, where every decision can alter the fate of the world.
70010000111686.intro: The year is 2071. As Tristan, you have to uncover secrets and solve puzzles to recover human consciousnesses in this neon-noir world with a low poly aesthetic inspired by the 90s.
70010000111686.name: Au Revoir

70010000117869.description:
The Fountain of Youth was hidden away. Nonetheless, it is fated that a Usurper will slay the Ageless and unearth it once more.

FOUNTAINS is a soulslike action-RPG built around fighting your way through a maze-like interconnected, seamless world. You'll take the role of a hooded stranger, recently imprisoned by a tyrannical regime. Will you escape and uncover the mysteries of this war-torn empire? 

Demanding, but fair combat
Tight, responsive combat puts every tool and tactic in your arsenal to the test, rewarding precision and quick thinking. Your enemies will hit hard and punish hesitation, turning each fight into an intense back-and-forth where the tide of battle can shift in an instant. Adjustable difficulty settings let you feel that thrill at exactly the intensity you crave, no matter your experience.

Exploration that rewards curiosity
The world of FOUNTAINS is one, seamless, giant dungeon. It is a tightly packed labyrinth which twists and loops back on itself. You'll always discover something new:  items, powers and upgrades to unlock new parts of the world.

Leave Your Mark
FOUNTAINS features an online message system. Leave hints throughout the world to help out your fellow players, or trick them into doing something foolish!

- Souls-like action combat set in a metroidvania-style interconnected world.
- Find new abilities and tools to help you to defend yourself and to traverse the world.
- Rich dark fantasy lore told through exploration and environmental storytelling.
- Online message system for community interaction.
- Secrets are everywhere, so always keep an eye out!
70010000117869.intro: Master high-skilled combat and explore a vast, interconnected world.
70010000117869.name: FOUNTAINS

70010000130035.description:
FIGHT THE DEAD. SURVIVE THE STREETS.

The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival challenges you to intense arcade brawling in the unforgiving world of AMC’s The Walking Dead.

Play as iconic survivors Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, and Michonne while fighting through walker-infested tunnels, devastated settlements, and hostile strongholds packed with explosive encounters. Face Alexandria’s most ruthless foes, the Saviors led by Negan, along with overwhelming waves of Walkers as you unleash crushing combos, signature weapon attacks, and devastating finishers in a relentless battle for survival.

INSPIRED BY THE STORY YOU KNOW. 
Based on the events of the All Out War storyline, fight through a campaign that reimagines the Saviors conflict that features walkers, threats, and surprises pulled from across the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. You’ll explore familiar environments from the show - including the Sanctuary, Hilltop, Alexandria – enhanced by dynamic set pieces, environmental hazards, and intense, story-driven moments.

ICONIC SURVIVORS. ICONIC WEAPONS.
Step into the boots of legendary characters from The Walking Dead, each with a unique fighting style, stats, and signature abilities inspired by the series. Rick’s magnum, Michonne’s katana, and Daryl’s trusty crossbow are all ready for battle.

FEATURES:
•        Hard-Hitting Arcade Beat ’Em Up Combat
Use brutal melee abilities, crowd-clearing ranged attacks, or a mix of the two in fast-paced skirmishes. Enjoy responsive, crisp, and satisfying fighting gameplay while exploring the apocalypse.

•        Overwhelming Walker Swarms & Ruthless Enemies
Battle through creeping armies of the undead and dangerous members of The Saviors that force you to adapt, assess threats, and fight for every inch of ground.

•        Face Iconic Bosses
Take on powerful, fan-favorite walkers like Winslow, the Well Walker, and more. The Saviors provide their own challenges as you throw down with Negan and Simon in intense, multi-phase boss battles that test your skill, strategy, and survival instincts.

•        Replayable Arcade Challenge
Master each character’s moveset and tackle multiple difficulty levels in an experience built for repeat runs and escalating challenges. Or jump in with an optional Easy Mode for casual play.
70010000130035.intro: Arcade Beat 'Em Up Action in the World of AMC's The Walking Dead
70010000130035.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival

70050000077190.description:
The world fell apart. Your weapons don’t have to look like it.

The Golden Survival Pack delivers a full set of premium gold-finished weapon skins for the survivors of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Outfit your arsenal with striking new looks of the iconic weaponry of The Walking Dead. Carve through walkers with Michonne’s katana, drop walkers with Daryl’s crossbow, or unload Rick’s magnum in the middle of a desperate last stand, every fight hits harder when your gear stands out against the ruins of the world.

Battle through the apocalypse with an arsenal forged to shine when everything else has gone dark. The Golden Survival Pack Includes 7 golden skins for iconic character weapons.
70050000077190.intro: Gold-polished gear for brutal fights and last stands.
70050000077190.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Golden Survival Pack

70050000077194.description:
The Arcade Apocalypse Pack expands the brutal world of AMC’s The Walking Dead with exclusive digital content built for survivors ready to push deeper into the apocalypse.

Push your skills to the limit in Walker Pit - an Endless Survival Mode, where every encounter becomes a desperate battle to stay alive against overwhelming odds. For survivors looking for the ultimate challenge, “Hell on Earth” difficulty strips away checkpoints and leaves no room for mistakes.

Also included are additional weapon & character skins, and the digital soundtrack.

The Arcade Apocalypse Pack includes:
•        2 Weapon Skins - Tactical Magnum and Unlockable Mystery Weapon Skin
•        1 Character Skin - Civic Republic Military Rick 
•        The Walker Pit - Endless Survival Combat Mode
•        HELL ON EARTH Difficulty mode - Hardcore Mode without Checkpoints
•        Digital Soundtrack
70050000077194.intro: More walkers, more game modes, more skins, and more digital bonus content.
70050000077194.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Arcade Apocalypse Pack

70070000036789.description:
Enjoy both games from the series The Grinch.
Includes:

The Grinch: Christmas Adventures
